data.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Content Intelligence
data.description:
Job Description

Arc XP is the AI-powered content platform for media companies. Purpose-built for publishers and broadcasters, it is the CMS and content platform that ambitious media organizations across digital media, news publishing, broadcast, and B2B publishing use to create and distribute content, grow and engage their audiences, and monetize through subscriptions and advertising. Fully leveraging AWS, the platform is built on a microservices architecture, and our teams deploy new features and products daily. Arc XP currently powers more than 1,500 sites in 25 countries that reach more than 1.5 billion unique visitors monthly.

This position sits on the Content Intelligence team, which builds and operates the AI systems that power Arc XP. The team owns the Arc Intelligence API, a multi-tenant LLM and vector platform used across Arc products; Ask the News, which provides retrieval-augmented answers over a publisher's own archive; and the intelligence layer behind our personalization and audience products.

These are production systems serving publishers across North America, Europe, Latin America, and APAC. They support a wide range of newsroom, audience, and business workflows, and that breadth shapes how we build: with strong tenant isolation, reliable retrieval, thoughtful controls, and careful attention to cost, performance, and trust at scale.

We are seeking a Senior Staff Software Engineer to lead technical direction across these systems. This is a senior individual contributor role with organizational technical leadership scope. You will define how these systems fit together, write the designs others build against, ship the hardest parts, and ensure the work scales across tenants, content models, languages, and operating requirements.

What Motivates You

  • You're motivated by powering journalism that millions of readers around the world rely on.
  • You develop clear, evidence-informed perspectives on quality and outcomes, and explain the reasoning behind them constructively.
  • You believe a feature isn't finished when it works, but when it is instrumented, observable, and documented well enough for someone else to pick up.
  • You don't wait for direction. You bring ideas forward, flag issues that deserve attention, and give leadership the input they need to make good decisions.
  • You have a bias for elegance, choosing simplification and consolidation over adding more layers of configuration and logic.
  • You thrive in fast-moving environments with many moving parts, shifting focus between priorities as the day unfolds.

How You'll Support the Mission

Platform Architecture

  • Own the end-to-end design of Arc's AI platform: model routing, prompt management, vector storage, and agentic runtimes.
  • Lead major architectural changes end to end, including solution design, security review, incremental rollout, and deprecation of what it replaced.
  • Set technical direction that holds across the organization, keeping decisions coherent with the services we depend on.

AI Quality and Evaluation

  • Own and evolve the evaluation infrastructure, keeping shared metrics reliable, relevant, and aligned with evolving quality needs.
  • Lead the safe adoption of new models through staged rollout practices, quality checks, and clear recovery paths.
  • Define and maintain AI guardrails that protect users, tenants, and platform reliability while keeping model capabilities aligned with product needs.

Multi-Tenancy, Security, and Privacy

  • Own the multi-tenancy model and enforce tenant isolation in all new development.
  • Partner with Security to strengthen privacy-by-default practices, with clear standards for data retention, minimization, erasure, and compliance controls.
  • Partner with Security on threat modeling, secure design reviews, and prioritizing vulnerability remediation.

Production Ownership and Delivery

  • Own the release train from customer test environments to production across regions, hotfixes included, without needing someone else to decide when it is safe to ship.
  • Participate in the on-call rotation.
  • Define and track key metrics for system health, customer activity, and business-critical workflows.
  • Partner with operations and customer enablement to streamline customer setup and onboarding.

Technical Leadership and Product Ownership

  • Drive what gets built. Bring ideas forward, shape the roadmap for your product area, and advocate for priorities with product and engineering leadership.
  • Lead mob programming sessions, design reviews, and architecture discussions, using them to raise engineering standards rather than simply approving changes.
  • Mentor and unblock other engineers through hands-on collaboration and design partnership.

The Skills and Experience You Bring

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years designing, building, and operating backend distributed systems at scale, including significant experience setting technical direction at the senior, staff, or principal level.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and architect across teams, influence technical direction without formal authority, and stay accountable for outcomes that depend on other teams' work.
  • Strong Python experience, including production API development with FastAPI or a close equivalent.
  • Deep AWS experience across core services, including Lambda, ECS, S3, CloudFront, DynamoDB, Bedrock, CodePipeline, and CodeBuild.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code frameworks, including Terraform, OpenTofu, Terragrunt, CloudFormation, or similar.
  • Hands-on experience building production AI systems: model routing, retrieval architecture, embedding and chunking strategy, reranking, streaming responses, guardrails, and evaluation harnesses.
  • Experience with multi-tenant SaaS architecture, including tenant isolation enforcement, per-tenant configuration, and usage metering.
  • Demonstrated written clarity across design documents, roadmaps, and runbooks — much of this role's leverage is text.

We weigh practical equivalent experience equally and do not require a formal degree.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Production-scale experience with vector embeddings, storage, and retrieval.
  • Familiarity with workflow orchestration frameworks, such as Temporal.
  • Familiarity with event streaming platforms, such as Kafka.
  • Experience with NoSQL and document databases, such as MongoDB Atlas.
  • Experience implementing observability with Datadog or comparable tooling, including APM, LLM observability, and application security monitoring.
  • Experience evaluating and integrating multiple model providers and hosting options.
  • Strong API and developer-experience craft: OpenAPI discipline, versioning, deprecation paths, backward compatibility, and predictable usage contracts.
  • Comfortable leveraging AI-assisted development tools, such as Claude Code, across prototyping, implementation, testing, and documentation while applying strong engineering judgment.
  • Experience evolving large-scale production systems while maintaining customer continuity across multiple languages or regions.
  • Media, publishing, or newsroom technology background.
  • Experience developing streaming media or rich content delivery workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with multimodal AI tools for media analysis and generation, including video, photo, or audio.

Compensation and Benefits

Wherever you are in your life or career, The Washington Post offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits for every step of your journey:

  • Competitive medical, dental and vision coverage

  • Company-paid pension and 401(k) match

  • Three weeks of vacation and up to three weeks of paid sick leave

  • Nine paid holidays and two personal days

  • 20 weeks paid parental leave for any new parent

  • Robust mental health resources

  • Backup care and caregiver concierge services

  • Gender affirming services

  • Pet insurance

  • Free Post digital subscription

  • Leadership and career development program

Benefits may vary based on the job, full-time or part-time schedule, location, and collectively bargained status

The salary range for this position is:

$144,600 - $241,100 Annual

The actual salary within this range will depend on individual skills, experience, and qualifications as they relate to specific job requirements. This position may be eligible for a bonus or incentive program, and a member of the Talent Acquisition team will discuss bonus payment terms and conditions during the interview process.

The Post strives to provide its readers with high-quality, trustworthy news and information while constantly innovating. That mission is best served by a diverse, multi-generational workforce with varied life experiences and perspectives. All cultures and backgrounds are welcomed.

data.title: Software Engineering Manager
data.description:
Software Engineering Manager

Location: Remote | Team: Engineering – Enterprise Learning & Skills

About the Role

We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a team of 5–8 software engineers on the Enterprise Learning & Skills (ELS) engineering team. The team builds, scales, and evolves a large-scale, API-driven platform used globally to issue and verify digital credentials. This is a people- and delivery-focused leadership role: you'll own the day-to-day health, output, and growth of the team, ensuring work stays on track, meets our standards for quality and consistency, and delivers what the organization and our customers expect.

You'll allocate and prioritize daily work, clear blockers, clarify requirements, and give real-time feedback so engineers can do their best work. You'll be the first line of support when coding or system issues surface, deciding what the team can resolve and what needs to be escalated to senior engineering leadership. You'll also own onboarding and skill development for new team members, and you'll partner closely with Product, Customer Success, and external vendors to turn requirements into reliable, well-sequenced delivery. You don't need to write production code, but you do need enough technical depth to guide design discussions, hold the team to strong engineering practices, and ask the right questions.

What You'll Do

  • Lead, coach, and support a team of 5–8 engineers building Ruby on Rails services and React frontends, owning the team's well-being, performance, and immediate output

  • Plan and allocate daily and sprint work, monitor progress against delivery schedules, and keep projects on track through clear priorities and timely course corrections

  • Troubleshoot obstacles, clarify requirements, and coordinate handoffs across engineers, teams, and vendors so blockers are resolved quickly and together

  • Triage bugs and production issues with attention to detail, minimizing disruption to the customers who rely on our platform

  • Maintain standards of quality and consistency within our defined processes, including coding and QA standards, code review coverage, test thoroughness, and team documentation

  • Give real-time, constructive feedback; run regular 1:1s; and celebrate team milestones while openly recognizing individual contributions

  • Own the onboarding and skill development of new team members, reducing ramp-up time and onboarding errors

  • Identify and introduce process improvements at the team level, within defined limits, and escalate unresolved or higher-impact issues to senior engineering leadership in a timely way

  • Champion the responsible use of AI-assisted development tools for coding, testing, documentation, and debugging across the team

  • Uphold secure, ethical, and resilient engineering practices, including data and information security expectations, across everything the team ships

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience and 2+ years managing or formally leading a software engineering team

  • Working familiarity with our core stack (Ruby on Rails, React, AWS, PostgreSQL) and with API management, cloud computing, DevOps practices, and software design, with enough technical acumen to guide discussions and evaluate trade-offs

  • Proven track record of running a team's daily delivery reliably: consistent adherence to coding and QA standards, accurate and timely task completion, and dependable schedules

  • Strong problem-solving skills, with a habit of identifying challenges early, evaluating options, and driving practical resolutions

  • Exceptional collaboration and communication, equally effective with engineers, non-technical stakeholders, and external vendors

  • Experience onboarding and developing engineers, with evidence of shortened ramp-up times and growing team capability

  • Sound judgment about when to resolve issues locally and when to escalate, and a record of escalating clearly and promptly

  • Adaptability and a commitment to continuous learning as the team, platform, and tooling evolve

  • Strong understanding of information and data security fundamentals and an ethical, customer-centric approach to decisions

AI-Native Expectations

You should be comfortable using AI tools in your own work and confident guiding a team that uses them for coding, testing, documentation, and learning. You'll set expectations for how AI-generated output is validated, help the team build sound judgment about when to rely on it and when not to, and stay curious about how AI agents and automated AI can responsibly improve productivity and quality across the team.

How Success Is Measured

High performers in this role are recognized by their team's consistent adherence to coding and QA standards, the speed and accuracy of task completion, and the reliability of daily delivery schedules. Timely escalation of unresolved issues, high coverage on code review, and the successful introduction of team-level process improvements are central to success. The readiness of new staff, evidenced by reduced ramp-up times and fewer onboarding errors, also features in performance assessment.

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on background as a Rails, React, or full-stack engineer before moving into management

  • Experience designing, deploying, or operating production workloads on AWS and Azure, and familiarity with CI/CD and automated deployment practices

  • Experience managing work delivered in partnership with third-party or vendor teams

  • Experience with resilience planning, incident management, or on-call processes for customer-facing systems

  • Experience with distributed or service-oriented systems and asynchronous, event-driven communication between services

  • Experience introducing AI agents or automated AI tooling into an engineering team's workflow

Applications will be accepted through October 1. This window may be extended depending on business needs.

Compensation at Pearson is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and specific location. The full-time salary range for this role is between $150,000 - $190,000

DLB Associates is a premier engineering and consulting firm specializing in innovative, mission-critical solutions across hyperscale data centers, advanced infrastructure, and high-performance building systems. Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Salary

DLB recognizes salary ranges from jobboardsdo not necessarily reflect our pay ranges. In many instances we out-compete those ranges for well-qualified candidates.

Positions are available in our Mission CriticalDepartment,which focuses primarily on hyperscale data centers and related mission critical facilities.

TheLeadElectrical Engineer, Datacenterwill have the opportunity to collaborate with all design staff and oversee full cycle electrical design activities. This person will work as part of the Engineering Team and interact closely with the Project Management Team to produce construction documents,developand edit projectspecificationsand lead the construction administration process.

TheLeadElectrical Engineer, Datacenter will be self-directed on day-to-day work and receive high level instruction on new projects or assignments. Will execute and lead design teams and design projects of complex scope. May coordinate activities of other personnel.

TheLeadElectrical Engineer, Datacenter will communicate andoperatein line with organizational goals and values, as well as departmentalobjectives.

Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

  • Advanced knowledge of mission critical electrical infrastructure including medium- and low-voltage power distribution, standby generation, UPS systems, grounding, lighting, life safety systems, and critical facility electrical design.
  • Knowledge of codes and specifications for the design of electrical systems including National Electric Code, Life Safety and Energy Conservation Codes

  • Knowledge of various electrical topologies and distribution systems

Physical Demands

PLUS

data.description:
Building anAI‑first organisationis central to Clinisys’ purpose and the impact we deliver. As a global provider of intelligent diagnostic informatics solutions, we build AI‑enabled, cloud‑based platforms to enhance diagnostic workflows across healthcare, life sciences, and public health. By applying intelligent technology thoughtfully and responsibly, we help laboratories and testing environments operate more effectively, generate meaningful insights at scale, and ultimately support healthier and safer communities. Operating across more than 30 countries, Clinisys expects all colleagues—regardless of role or function — to work confidently with AI‑enabled tools, apply digital and analytical thinking, and continuously adapt as technologies evolve, must drive an AI first sense of purpose and urgency.

Clinisys has built an unrivalled reputation for deploying complex diagnostic networks and academic centres – and is the only provider to repetitively deliver to all disciplines end-to-end – at scale. Fostering healthier communities.

Job Description:

  • Carry out software installation and configuration of laboratory systems

  • Integrate software into laboratory workflows, including mapping daily routines

  • Implement Laboratory Information System (LIS) projects

  • Act as a subject matter expert in your field

  • Serve as a trusted technical contact for customers during assignments and projects

  • Support the adoption of emerging technologies, including data-driven and AI-enabled solutions

  • Identify opportunities to optimise laboratory workflows and system performance where relevant

Responsibilities

  • Work with the Project Manager or Customer Services Manager and follow their guidance and planning.

  • Make proposals and identify technical risks, including those related to data integrity and AI-enabled functionalities, and communicate them clearly.

  • Prepare execution plans and relevant documentation.

data.title: HMI Schematics Designer
data.description:
ABOUT POWER FACTORS

Power Factors is a software and solutions provider leading the next generation of clean energy with Unity, one of the most extensive and widely deployed renewable energy management suites (REMS) in the market. With over 300 GW of wind, solar, and energy storage assets managed worldwide across more than 600 customers and 18,000 sites, Power Factors manages 25% of the world’s renewable energy data.*

Power Factors’ Unity REMS supports the entire energy value chain, from monitoring and controls to market analytics. The company’s suite of open, data-driven applications empowers renewable energy stakeholders to collaborate, automate critical workflows, and make more informed decisions to maximize asset returns. Energy stakeholders receive end-to-end support, including solutions for SCADA & PPC, centralized monitoring, performance management, commercial asset management, and field service management.

With deep domain expertise, AI-powered insights are delivered at scale so businesses can optimize assets, unlock growth, and make smarter decisions as the world rapidly transitions to clean energy. Power Factors fights climate change with code.

* Outside China and India

ABOUT THE ROLE

As an HMI Schematics Designer on our SCADA Delivery team, you will design and update HMI schematics for the Unity SCADA platform. You’ll work from Technical Manager (TM) inputs and client-specific templates, making sure every schematic is accurate, consistent with client requirements, and delivered on time from first draft through final client approval.

What you’ll do

Ticket management

  • Review and manage HMI schematics creation tickets submitted to the USIB Jira board by Technical Managers and Project Managers
  • Verify tickets are complete: project type (PV, BESS, Hybrid), provisioning portal, client, applicable template, and any specific requirements
  • Track tickets through the USIB Jira board stages

Input collection and coordination

  • Gather the inputs needed to build schematics screens, such as SLDs and client-specific requests
  • Work with TMs, PMs, and clients to resolve missing or unclear inputs before design begins

Schematics creation, review, and approval

  • Create Unity SCADA HMI schematics from the provided inputs, client templates, and project requirements
  • Review completed schematics internally and make any needed fixes
  • Send schematics to the client for review and address comments until final approval
  • Upload approved schematics to all required portals, including cloud and local instances provided to the client

Change requests and Unity Portal updates

  • Review change requests from TMs and PMs on the USIB Jira board and implement the specified updates or corrections
  • Review Unity Portal updates communicated by TMs and PMs to confirm schematics screens still operate correctly

AI-assisted engineering

  • Use AI tools to speed up schematics design and review, and validate outputs for accuracy, completeness, and compliance before client delivery
  • Use AI tools to check adherence to client-specific templates and standards, and help improve design quality and consistency over time

REQUIREMENTS

  • Experience (or strong interest) in HMI/SCADA schematics design [add years of experience for the level you’re hiring]
  • Familiarity with PV, BESS, and/or Hybrid project types [adjust by level]
  • Ability to read and work from single-line diagrams (SLDs) and client templates
  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy and template consistency
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including writing client-facing comments and change notes
  • Comfort working in Jira-based ticket workflows
  • Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders (TMs, PMs, clients) and chase down missing information
  • Willingness to use AI tools in your daily engineering work and to check their output carefully
  • Nice to have: experience with Unity SCADA

LIFE @ POWER FACTORS

We are an agile software development company – big enough to make an impact, but small enough to move quickly and execute in a growing industry. We are a team of bold and ingenious talents driven by results. We are passionate about making the world a better place. We seek fierce and humble people to help us achieve our ambitious plan.

WHY JOIN US

By joining the Power Factors team, you’ll be part of a dynamic group of innovative and driven individuals dedicated to making a positive impact. Every day, your work will directly contribute to advancing clean energy solutions and supporting global sustainability initiatives. Our culture runs deep and shows up in how we work together - committed, conscientious and collaborative. With many opportunities for professional growth, Power Factors is here to support your development as we lead the charge in transforming the energy industry.

WE ARE AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Power Factors is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to engaging a diverse workforce and sustaining an inclusive culture. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

About Voltus

Voltus is a leading company for Distributed Energy Resources (DERs). Our mission is to be the platform that fulfills the promise of the energy transition. The Voltus platform connects any DER to any energy market across the US and Canada, providing flexibility, reliability, and resilience to the grid while generating revenue for our partners.

We hire teammates who are bright, gritty, and good and who have a genuine passion for delivering a cleaner energy future and for working in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. We are a remote and virtual company, distributed across US, Canada, and abroad.

The Role

Voltus is hiring for multiple roles at the senior level on several teams. As a Senior Engineer you will find a home on one of these teams and assume a technical leadership role in our backend solutions and front end technologies where appropriate to the team. You'll join a fully remote team tackling complex energy industry challenges, collaborating with experienced engineers on our modern tech stack, and contributing to core systems that decarbonize the grid.

Your work will involve building core backend logic, APIs, designing data pipelines, or creating customer interfaces. A strong candidate can speak to their alignment with our core values of bright, gritty, and good, and you want to work with others like you in a highly collaborative environment.

Technologies We Use

We build scalable software using Python, Postgres, Go, FastAPI, Temporal, Delta Lake, Clickhouse, Typescript, and React, running our services using Docker and the HashiCorp stack on AWS. We do not expect candidates to have a background in every tool listed here; instead, we place a high value on strong foundational programming skills and a genuine eagerness to learn and grow. Successful candidates can demonstrate significant depth in some of core technologies.

Responsibilities

    • Assume a technical leadership role, with other senior engineers, for the team’s solutions bringing past experiences to improve our coding practices and team principals and operating procedures.

    • Represent engineering in close collaboration with our product and design teams and internal stakeholders including technical requirements gathering

    • Author and support process and design documentation and exemplify best practices by example

    • Work principally in the backend and data handling layers of our technology stack with front end development on occasion

Qualifications

    • Minimum of 8 years of experience as a code-contributing engineer

    • Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent combination of education and experience, in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.

    • Multiple years of experience working in one or more of our foundational backend technologies and with databases

    • An empathetic individual who cares about engineering culture with demonstrated contributions to team culture and engineering best practices

    • A strong collaborator who understands what it means to be a force multiplier

    • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

    • A genuine passion for our mission to create a cleaner, more resilient energy future.

    • Authorization to work in the US or Canada without sponsorship

**Please include a link to your GitHub account in your application (in the “links” section). Applications without a GitHub account will not be considered**

Please note that at this time, we do not sponsor visas or transfers for new hires. Voltus teammates need to be authorized to work from their home location (in the US or Canada, unless otherwise indicated on the role description).

Additionally, while Voltus is an all-remote workplace, we have limitations on where employees are able to work for regulatory and security reasons. We expect that Voltans are working primarily from their home country. Working while traveling to other countries must be approved as per our Global Remote Travel Policy.

At Voltus, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer because we recognize that a diverse organization begins with a diverse candidate pool. This means we do not tolerate discrimination of any kind and are committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of your gender identity, race, nationality, religion, age, sexual orientation, veteran status, disability status, or marital status.

Headquarters: Remote, Colorado, United States, AMER

From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the role

The Global Alliance Lead is one of the most strategically important roles in our Ecosystem. You will own our relationship with one of the world's leading technology and transformation partners end-to-end — from C-suite engagement through to practitioner enablement and joint pipeline creation. You will be the architect of how the GSI and NewCo go to market together, ensuring our platform becomes the trusted data foundation inside the GSI’s agentic AI delivery practice globally.

This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the Global Head of GSI Relationships. You will orchestrate across sales, partner solution architecture, marketing, and partner operations — bringing the full weight of the organisation to bear on one of our highest-leverage commercial relationships.

What You'll Do

Relationship strategy and executive engagement

  • Own the global GSI relationship at partner and C-suite level, building trusted relationships with Client, practice and delivery team leads.
  • Define and execute a multi-year joint strategy that positions dbt + Fivetran as the default open data infrastructure layer within the GSI’s enterprise AI and agentic workflow delivery
  • Represent NewCo at GSI’s internal forums, client briefings, and industry events — articulating a compelling narrative around open data infrastructure and its relevance to the GSI’s strategy. 

Platform integration and practitioner adoption

  • Drive adoption of the dbt + Fivetran platform within GSI delivery teams — ensuring practitioners, solution architects and practice leads are certified, confident, and actively recommending the platform in client engagements
  • Work with GSI's practice leadership to embed NewCo's platform into their business groups, standard delivery architectures, RFP responses and client proposals — with particular focus on GSI's Data & AI practices

Enablement and go-to-market

  • Design and execute a frictionless enablement programme for GSI practitioners globally — certifications, reference architectures, use case playbooks, and joint delivery assets
  • Partner with GSI's marketing and alliances teams to develop joint go-to-market campaigns anchored to open data infrastructure, trusted AI delivery, and closing the gap between AI POC and production
  • Support GSI in building and positioning client-facing agentic AI value accelerators — with NewCo platform as the foundational data layer — the "NewCo inside" model

Pipeline and opportunity development

  • Source and develop new pipeline opportunities through the GSI relationship — identifying client situations where open data infrastructure creates measurable value.
  • Drive co-sell motions alongside GSI account teams, ensuring NewCo is present and influential at the point of client opportunity
  • Maintain a rigorous view of GSI-engaged pipeline — tracking opportunity sourcing, progression, and closed business attributed to the alliance

Telemetry and performance

  • Define and track the signals that indicate a healthy, high-performing GSI relationship: certifications, sourced opportunities, platform deployments, practitioner engagement, and joint wins
  • Report regularly to the Global Head of GSI Relationships on alliance health, pipeline contribution, and strategic progress
  • Identify risks and gaps in the relationship early and mobilise internal resources to address them

What you will bring

  • 15+ years of experience in strategic alliances, enterprise sales, or partner management within the data, cloud, or enterprise software industry
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex, global relationships with major consulting firms or global system integrators at a senior level
  • Deep understanding of the modern data stack and the business value of open data infrastructure — dbt, Fivetran, or equivalent experience strongly preferred
  • Ability to engage credibly at C-suite and partner level within a global consulting organisation — understanding how GSIs make decisions, build practices, and go to market
  • Strong commercial instincts — able to identify, thoroughly qualify and develop joint pipeline opportunities, not just manage existing relationships
  • Track record of operating as a cross-functional orchestrator — influencing without direct authority across sales, engineering, marketing, and operations
  • Exceptional communication and storytelling skills — able to translate technical platform capabilities into compelling business narratives for consulting and enterprise audiences
  • Familiarity with AI, agentic workflows, and the data governance landscape is a strong advantage + strong knowledge of GSI's operating model and contacts within. 
  • Willingness to travel globally to engage GSI leadership and teams across regions

What Success Looks Like in Year One

  • A clearly defined joint strategy with GSI signed off at partner Executive level and on track to primary Global Strategic Practice.
  • Material increase in GSI practitioner certifications and active platform deployments across Data & AI and Insights & Data practices
  • GSI-sourced pipeline contributing measurably to NewCo's revenue
  • At least two joint go-to-market campaigns live in the market delivering pipeline — anchored to GSI's agentic AI and trusted data agenda
  • First client-facing agentic value accelerators built on NewCo platform delivered with GSI — positioning NewCo as the trusted data infrastructure inside GSI's AI delivery
  • A telemetry framework in place tracking alliance health and pipeline influence

Why This Role

This is a rare opportunity to own a marquee relationship at a defining moment for both companies. GSI’s are publicly committing to capturing the full value of the agentic AI revolution for customers  — and the merged dbt + Fivetran platform is the trusted data infrastructure that makes AI production-ready. The person who builds this alliance well will sit at the intersection of the two most important forces in enterprise technology right now: the scale of a global systems integrator and the open infrastructure that makes AI trustworthy enough to deploy at scale.

This position qualifies for Fivetran’s incentive plan, and it’s common for employees in this role to achieve the total on-target earnings.

Founded in 2014 by CEO Kate Ryder, Maven Clinic has raised more than $425 million from leading healthcare and technology investors including General Catalyst, Sequoia, Dragoneer Investment Group, Oak HC/FT, StepStone Group, Icon Ventures, and Lux Capital. Recognized for innovation and industry leadership, Maven has been named to the TIME100 Most Influential Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and FORTUNE Best Places to Work. Learn more at mavenclinic.com

An award-winning culture working towards an important mission –  Maven Clinic is a recipient of over 30 workplace and innovation awards, including: 

  • TIME 100 Most Influential Companies (2023, 2026)
  • Fortune Change the World (2024)
  • CNBC Disruptor 50 List (2022, 2023, 2024)
  • Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials (2024)
  • Fortune Best Workplaces in Health Care (2024)
  • Fast Company Most Innovative Companies (2020, 2023)
  • Fortune Best Workplaces NY (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024)

About the Role: 

We are looking for a mission-driven health coach to join our team to provide world-class care delivery services to Maven members. Our Care Delivery team consists of care coaches and care advocates who help our members navigate digital care and access the tools to unlock their best experience and outcomes. Our team works to continuously learn more about members and ourselves, and you’ll move fast to adapt and grow as we implement data-driven strategies for improving the lives of our members through a shared coaching model. As a Care Coach, you’ll coordinate care for our members beyond the digital space. Through goal setting and program opt-in, you’ll drive behavior change and improved outcomes for higher risk members. 

Our Care Delivery team works remotely and supports Maven members 24/7/365. We are currently hiring for the following shift:

  • Monday-Friday 3-11:30p EST

What You’ll Do:

  • Drive program engagement by clearly communicating the value of Maven’s care coaching model, optimizing opt-in rates, and supporting long-term behavior change
  • Co-create SMART goals with members and own their progress by tracking adherence, adjusting care plans, and course-correcting within Maven’s clinical program design
  • Manage a caseload of members and engage with them through ongoing messaging, video appointments, and outreach
  • Adhere to clinical program guidelines and protocols while utilizing motivational interviewing skills and behavior modification techniques to remove barriers, influence sustained behavior change, and promote optimal health outcomes for members
  • Move fast to assess member knowledge and barriers and provide personalized health education to members across varying ages, backgrounds, cultures, and literacy levels
  • Collaborate with providers on members’ care teams to translate clinical recommendations into actionable next steps
  • Lead with data by remotely monitoring member health data and platform activity to identify risks early and follow established protocols and procedures to take appropriate action
  • Remove barriers to care by coordinating seamlessly across Maven’s digital network, in-person provider networks, and external partners as needed
  • Embrace a continuous-learning mindset by participating in and leading efforts to improve quality of care and clinical outcomes
  • Act as a team player by providing coverage to ensure that all members across the Maven platform receive appropriate care and timely responses when needed

What You’ll Bring: 

  • 1- 2+ years experience in clinical work as a nurse (RN) with focus on patient education, motivational interviewing, and driving clinical outcomes
  • Demonstrated experience working with the maternity population and/or individuals navigating family planning or fertility care (trying to conceive, undergoing fertility treatment)
  • Training and experience coaching individuals to achieve specific health outcomes (ie, medication management, nutrition and exercise goals, managing blood pressure)
  • Ability to remain flexible with changes, work efficiently to meet member demand and have a growth mindset
  • Ability to communicate with patients empathetically in writing and verbally, and passionate about creating a positive member experience with optimal outcomes  
  • Experience achieving KPIs relevant to patient outcomes, including but not limited to opt-in rates, follow-up adherence and member satisfaction 
  • Demonstrated ability to quickly learn and adapt to new digital health tools and platforms, with comfort operating in a fast-changing tech environment
  • Embrace AI tools as part of daily workflows to enhance efficiency and improve member outcomes
  • Strong telehealth competency, including comfort in conducting phone outreach and video calls. Reliable access to high-speed internet
  • Health coaching certification (NBC-HWC or ICF) is preferred, not required 
  • Experience in a start-up or fast-paced environment with ability to navigate systems quickly and adapt to change is preferred, not required 
  • Experience coaching across multiple modalities such as video, text/chat, and phone; adapting communication style to fit member need is preferred, not required 
  • Comfort with technology tools like Google suite, CRM platforms, EHRs, and Zendesk is preferred, not required 

The base salary range for this role is $62,000 - $78,000 per year. You will also be entitled to receive equity and benefits. Individual pay decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, and skillset.

This role requires active work authorization in the US.

Maven embraces a flexible and inclusive work environment. This role is open to candidate in: AZ, DC, DE, FL, GA, HI, IL, KS, MA, MD, ME, MI, MN, MO, NC, NJ, NM, NV, NY, OH, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, VA, VT, WI. Maven is committed to supporting remote team members with the tools and collaborative culture needed to thrive regardless of location. This policy reflects our belief that great work can happen anywhere and that flexibility enables our team to do their best work.

At Maven we believe that a diverse set of backgrounds and experiences enrich our teams and allow us to achieve above and beyond our goals. If you do not have experience in all of the areas detailed above, we hope that you will share your unique background with us in your application and how it can be additive to our teams.

Benefits That Work For You

Our benefits are designed to support your health, well-being and career development, helping you thrive both personally and professionally. We remain focused on providing a competitive benefits package for our employees. On top of standards such as employer-covered health, dental, and insurance plan options, we offer an inclusive approach to benefits:

  • Maven for Mavens: access to the full platform and specialists, including care for mental health, reproductive health, family planning and pediatrics.
  • Whole-self care through wellness partnerships
  • Hybrid work, in office meals, and work together days 
  • 16 weeks 100% paid parental leave and new parent stipend (for Mavens who've been with us for 1 year+)
  • Annual professional development stipend and access to a personal career coach through Maven for Mavens
  • 401K matching for US-based employees, with immediate vesting

These benefits are applicable to Maven Clinic Co., US-based, full-time employees only. 1099/Contract Providers are ineligible for these benefits. 

Maven is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information. Maven is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. Maven Clinic interview requests and job offers only originate from an @mavenclinic.com email address (e.g jsmith@mavenclinic.com). Maven Clinic will never ask for sensitive information to be delivered over email or phone. If you receive a scam issue or a security issue involving Maven Clinic please notify us at: security@mavenclinic.com. For general and additional inquiries, please contact us at careers@mavenclinic.com.

data.description:
Job Title: Software Engineer, Platform Engineering

Job Type: Full-time

Location: Remote

The Role

We're looking for a Full-Stack Engineer who enjoys building things from scratch, taking ownership, and moving fast.

Ideally, you've been part of a small engineering team at a fast-growing startup, helping build and scale products as the company evolved through different stages of growth.

You'll work on the internal tools, services, and workflows that power our operations, products, and AI-driven infrastructure.

What You'll Own

  1. Build and scale full-stack applications using React, Node.js, and TypeScript.
  2. Own features and systems end-to-end, from architecture to production.
  3. Develop reliable backend services, APIs, and performant frontend interfaces.
  4. Design and optimize databases, data models, and queries.
  5. Work closely with product, operations, and design to turn ideas into working solutions.
  6. Improve platform reliability, performance, and developer experience.
  7. Make practical technical decisions while balancing speed, quality, and scalability.
  8. Troubleshoot production issues and continuously improve existing systems.

What We're Looking For

  1. 4+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  2. Strong hands-on experience with JavaScript/TypeScript, React, and Node.js across the full stack.
  3. Experience as an early member of an engineering team, helping a startup grow and scale over time.
  4. A track record of building and scaling products in high-growth startup environments.
  5. AI-native mindset: You actively use AI coding tools (like Cursor, Claude Code, or similar) as part of your daily workflow and know how to get the most out of them.
  6. Experience taking products from idea to production and adapting systems as the business grows.
  7. Solid experience with PostgreSQL or similar relational databases.
  8. Experience with REST APIs, cloud platforms (AWS or similar), and modern backend architectures.
  9. Comfortable working with ambiguity, making decisions independently, and taking ownership of your work.
  10. A hands-on, problem-solving mindset with a bias toward shipping.

Nice to Have

  1. Experience with NestJS, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, or DevOps.
  2. Experience building internal tools, developer platforms, or workflow automation.
  3. Exposure to AI-powered or data-heavy products.
  4. Experience improving architecture and engineering processes as a startup scales.
  5. Familiarity with monitoring, observability, and system reliability.

Compensation & Benefits Notice

The national pay range for this full-time position is base salary of $120,000 –$160,000 USD. All employees are eligible for equity compensation, and employees may also receive performance-based bonuses, dependent on role and subject to company policies. micro1 provides a comprehensive benefits package, including up to 100% reimbursement for health-insurance premiums, paid time off, a 401(K) plan with a company match, and additional benefits designed to support a high-performing, remote-first workforce.

micro1 is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation during the application process, reach out to .

Our hiring process utilizes artificial intelligence tools to assist in candidate screening and assessment. Our AI tools are designed to complement, not replace, human decision-making.

Innodata (Nasdaq: INOD) is a global data engineering company. We believe that data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) are inextricably linked. Our mission is to enable the responsible advancement of artificial intelligence by providing the data, evaluation frameworks, and human expertise required to build AI systems that can be trusted at scale. We provide a range of transferable solutions, platforms, and services for Generative AI / AI builders and adopters. In every relationship, we honor our 36+ year legacy delivering the highest quality data and outstanding outcomes for our customers.

About the Role:

We build an advanced data platform that helps demanding enterprise and public-sector customers turn large, complex datasets into high-quality, structured data for AI. We're a small, senior team that values ownership, correctness, and strong engineering. We're hiring a full-stack engineer to help build and operate the product end to end, and to work closely with the customers who use it. You'll spend most of your time building, with regular chances to join customer conversations, help deploy the platform in their environments, and see how it's used in the field. It's a great fit for an engineer who enjoys working with customers and wants to grow into a more customer-facing role.

What You'll Do:

  • Build features end to end across our Rust backend and TypeScript/React frontend, from the data model and APIs to a polished, interactive web application.
  • Design data models, APIs, and ingestion pipelines that are fast and reliable at scale.
  • Help deploy, configure, and support the platform in cloud and customer environments, including AWS GovCloud, on-premises Kubernetes, and air-gapped or classified networks.
  • Build data connectors and integrations that bring customer data into the platform and fit it to their workflows.
  • Join customer conversations, demos, and occasional on-site visits to understand how the product is used, and turn that feedback into product improvements.
  • Contribute to architecture, code quality, performance, and security as the product grows.

What We're Looking For:

  • 5+ years building and shipping production software.
  • Active Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility (U.S. citizenship required).
  • Strong backend skills in a modern systems or application language (we work primarily in Rust; we're happy to help a strong engineer ramp up).
  • Solid SQL and PostgreSQL fundamentals — indexing, transactions, and query performance.
  • Proficiency with TypeScript and React and an eye for clean, responsive UIs.
  • Experience deploying and running services with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Strong communication skills — able to explain technical work clearly to customers and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to travel to customer sites.

Nice to Have:

  • Customer-facing, consulting, or solutions-engineering experience.

  • Experience with data-intensive applications, data pipelines, or Python for data work.

Core Technologies:

  • Rust · TypeScript / React · PostgreSQL · Python · cloud object storage · Docker · Kubernetes · AWS (including GovCloud). (Additional components shared during the interview process.)

Eligibility:

  • U.S. citizenship and an active Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility are required. This role is open to candidates anywhere in the U.S. (remote) or hybrid in the Washington, DC area, with occasional travel to customer sites.

data.title: Agentic Engineer (f/m/d)
data.description:
what to expect

We are a startup digital agency, and no two projects, clients, or even days look the same. But all of our days are agentic-first.

In ecommerce we build on Shopify and Liquid and Next.js, with custom AWS microservices and apps that take Shopify well past the defaults.

On the marketing side we build highly customised sites in Next.js and React, with careful design and animation and a real focus on how the page performs and feels.

In automotive and other industries we build full platforms, AI tools and integrations, from stock-car locators to configurators and a lot more.

Across all of it, we bring AI into the work through our own products.

Here nothing will be fixed. You will work across changing projects and settings, on long builds that run for months and shorter spikes to figure out how a business can actually use AI, and you will help us rethink how agency work is done.

Sound like your kind of place? Here is what we need from you.

your competencies

We're looking for engineers who are excited by agentic and AI-native systems - turning models into products that hold up under real users, real load, and real time. You'll build LLM integrations, agents, and RAG pipelines, treat prompt engineering as a code discipline, and make systems reliable through evaluation, guardrails, and solid testing. Whether you're building your craft or already shaping the AI architecture of a project, we want to hear from you. We hire across levels - here's what each looks like at OH-SO:

Junior AI/Agentic Engineer

You're building your engineering craft - curious about why and how things work, not afraid to get your hands dirty, and eager to grow. You implement from clear briefs - LLM integrations, prompt scaffolding, RAG components - and write the tests and evaluations that keep them honest, comfortable using AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) under supervision. You want to understand why and how we're building things, ask what the purpose and the constraint are before you start, and your work is reviewed before it merges.

AI/Agentic Engineer (typically 2-3+ years)

You own an AI feature end-to-end - an agent flow, a RAG pipeline, an integration across its error paths and guardrails - delivered independently with light oversight. You build evaluation harnesses to prove quality rather than assume it, use AI coding tools autonomously in production, and contribute to the shared AI backbone (the AI-brain MCP and skill library).

Senior AI/Agentic Engineer (typically 5+ years)

You own the AI outcome of a project - you define the integration shape, the multi-agent architecture and orchestration, the evaluation strategy and guardrails, and you write the ADRs that document why. You're the technical credibility in the room, contribute patterns and skills back to the shared backbone, and mentor the engineers around you. You use AI to define new ways of working, and you think in long runtime: the AI landscape will shift underneath the project, so you build for inheritance and replaceable layers. You help us move forward as an organization and you act as an AI evangelist.

What you bring to the table, at any level:

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI systems in production - integration, agents, RAG, or similar

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals in Python and/or TypeScript, and confidence designing and working with APIs

  • A habit of treating prompt engineering as a code discipline — with a real understanding of evaluation, guardrails, and reliability

  • A solid grasp of testing and quality: you build systems that hold up under real use, not just in a demo

  • A genuine interest in agentic systems and where the AI landscape is heading - and the judgement to apply it well, not just talk about it

  • Openness to collaborating with cross-functional teams - from designers to strategists - as well as directly with clients

  • You’re enjoying being part of a team, not a remote desk which prefers to work in isolation most of the time.

what you can look forward to

The stack you’ll work with:

  • Languages & core: Python and/or TypeScript, strong RESTful API design

  • AI & agents: LLM integration, RAG and vector databases, agent frameworks, multi-agent orchestration, MCP and agent infrastructure, prompt engineering, context and memory management, evaluation and guardrails

  • Testing & quality: automated testing, evaluation harnesses, observability and monitoring of AI systems

  • Cloud & infrastructure: cloud platforms, containerisation with Docker and Kubernetes, CI/CD (infrastructure-as-code with Terraform a plus)

  • AI tooling: Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Google Antigravity

Who you will work with

We are a bunch of colleagues originally from similar backgrounds who got tired of how things were usually done and set out to find better ways. That is the whole reason this company exists, and it is still what we are doing.

We are not a place of rockstars and egos. People here ask questions out loud, show rough work without flinching, and would rather help each other get something right than look clever alone. We push each other, in the good way, and we do not take ourselves too seriously while we are at it.

You would be joining that. You’ll work closely with the crafts, designers and strategists, and just as easily with the people steering the projects and the business. There is no wall between you and any of it. Take on the parts you are ready for, and when you want more, a pitch, a client conversation, a bigger call, speak up at the right moment and the door is open.

Smaller team. More ownership. Bigger work.

experience_requirements.text: 5+ years of professional experience in FPGA development of RF DSP and translating prototype algorithms into FPGA implementations

data.description:
About the role

Muon Space seeks a talented Senior FPGA Engineer with RF DSP Expertise to join our High Performance Compute team. In this role, you will implement HDL for digital signal processing of RF systems on FPGAs, and design and optimize these algorithms. You'll work at the intersection of RF theory, DSP algorithm development, software defined radio (SDR), and high performance digital FPGA design to deliver high-performance wireless communication and RF sensing products. If you thrive on complex challenges in a dynamic startup environment and want to build the future of Earth observation, we want to hear from you.

This role is remote eligible.

Responsibilities

  • Implement and optimize DSP algorithms on FPGAs for real-time execution; support algorithm prototyping in Python and porting to ARM SoCs
  • Design, simulate, and implement DSP algorithms for RF applications (Communications, ESM, Radar, etc.)
  • Collaborate with RF hardware engineers on instrument bring-up, calibration routines, and system integration, and team up with other software departments
  • Author technical documentation, design specifications, and test reports

Qualifications

  • BS/MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field
  • 5+ years of professional experience in FPGA development of RF DSP and translating prototype algorithms into FPGA implementations
  • Experience with general RF digital signal processing techniques in some of the following areas: spectrum monitoring, signal intelligence, modulation/demodulation, filtering, channel estimation, equalization, synchronization, AGC, DPD, etc.
  • Profound expertise in HDL (Verilog / System Verilog / VHDL) and FPGA system architecture and design flows
  • Ability to work with a distributed, interdisciplinary team (scientists, engineers, data support, etc.)
  • Familiarity with modern software development tooling and best practices
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in systems analysis, troubleshooting and design, with a strong understanding of the interplays between hardware and software
  • Experience working with a distributed team of developers across multiple groups and departments
  • Familiarity with Xilinx/AMD RFSoC or MPSoC
  • Proficiency in C/C++ or Rust for embedded/real-time systems
  • Experience with Python-based development and analysis
  • Familiarity with FPGA-based DSP techniques
    • DPD (Digital Predistortion), beamforming, MIMO, or radar signal processing
    • Communications: Modulation schemes (QAM, OFDM, FSK), channel coding, multirate signal processing, and adaptive filtering
    • RF concepts: mixers, PLLs, ADCs/DACs, IQ imbalance, frequency planning, link budgets
    • Calibration algorithms (DC offset, IQ correction, LO leakage)
  • Experience working on space-based applications
  • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines for embedded firmware
  • Proficient with version control (Git), debugging tools (JTAG, GDB), and lab instrumentation

What You’ll Bring

  • A systems-level mindset that connects RF physics, DSP mathematics, and FPGA implementation
  • Strong analytical and debugging skills for solving RF/FPGA hardware bugs
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a cross-functional team
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Salary

The salary range for this role is $158,000-$223,000K, plus a competitive equity grant and comprehensive benefits package. Final compensation will be determined based on skills, qualifications, experience, and geographic location as assessed during the interview process.

About Muon Space

Founded in 2021, Muon Space is an end-to-end Space Systems Provider that designs, builds, and operates LEO satellite constellations delivering mission-critical data. Our revolutionary, integrated technology stack enables customers to optimize every dimension of their missions for faster time-to-orbit and superior constellation remote sensing performance. Our state-of-the-art facility in the heart of Silicon Valley is optimized for manufacturing spacecraft and rapid, flexible payload integration at scale. From climate monitoring to national security, Muon Space is dedicated to delivering Earth Intelligence for a safer and more resilient world.

Taking Care of Our Team

At Muon salary is only part of our total compensation package. In addition to salary, full-time employees receive equity compensation as well as benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401k retirement plan, short & long term disability and life insurance. We also offer three weeks paid vacation for new employees, along with 12 paid holidays, unlimited sick time and paid parental leave.

Our mission embraces the entire planet and we believe our team should too. Muon is dedicated to creating a diverse and dynamic company and workforce. We believe in equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, age, national origin, citizenship, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or gender identity. We value diversity in the workplace, and that starts with our applicants. We encourage you to apply, even if you don't check all the boxes, and we look forward to reviewing your application! In addition, if you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know.

Muon is currently registered and able to hire in the following states:
AL, AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, FL, GA, IL, IA, ID, MD, MA, MI, MN, MO, NJ, NY, NC, OH, OR, PA, TN, TX, VT, VA, WA

ITAR/EAR Requirements

This position requires access to export controlled information. To conform to U.S. Government export regulations applicable to that information, applicant must either be (A) a U.S. person, defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, (B) eligible to access the export controlled information without a required export authorization, or (C) eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the required export authorization from the applicable U.S. government agency. The Company may, for legitimate business reasons, decline to pursue any export licensing process.

Job Title: Field Engineer II

Department: Service Management Office > Network Operation Center

Reports to: Field Engineering Manager

Location: Remote, but located in the Seattle, WA area

Overview - About NoaNet

NoaNet is a non-profit mutual corporation providing telecom solutions and services and is headquartered in Spokane Valley, Washington. For over 20 years, NoaNet has operated a reliable public open-access broadband network that today totals over 3,800 fiber miles and touches every county in Washington State. Our organization provides rural areas access to broadband services, supporting more than 100 last-mile providers that serve more than 260,000 customers. NoaNet’s owner/members are nine public utility districts and a joint operating agency. Learn more about NoaNet at

CJIS Clearance Required: Yes

Career Overview

  • Field Engineers (FE) use their technical expertise and project management skills to provide critical network support to NoaNet customers. Doing so requires the application of a range of services and engineering solutions involving different modes of communication and information transfer, such as wireless telephony services, radio and satellite communications, optical, internet and broadband technologies.
  • Field Engineers are assigned a specific geographic area and are responsible for all order fulfilments therein. FEs work both independently and in concert with the NOC, Sales and OFT departments to meet customer needs. FEs use their own knowledge, experience, technical know-how and independent judgement to answer and resolve customer inquiries, engineer services, complete orders, facilitate and implement solutions. FE’s provide a range of services and solutions to internal stakeholders, customers and network providers.
  • Most FE work is carried out on an order/project basis with tight deadlines and well-defined milestones for delivering project objectives. FEs manage all aspects of service delivery including customer coordination and planning, service design and configuration, hardware installation, testing, performance verification and CSM (Customer Service Management). FEs also prepare detailed technical and operational documents to be utilized by the customer and/or other departments.

Responsibilities

  • Available for on-call support 24/7/365 (excluding scheduled PTO)
  • Consulting and engineering services to internal stakeholders, customers and network providers
  • Performs the technical evaluation needed to address a given concern
  • Prepares the technical documentation for systems and telecommunication solutions/requisitions
  • Daily travel to customer job sites
  • Planning and coordinating with customers
  • Provide network engineering expertise to network providers
  • Installation, testing and verification of network equipment
  • Configuring and troubleshooting Ethernet circuits (VLANs)
  • Configuring and troubleshooting Optical Networks (DWDM, SONET, etc.)
  • Collaboration with the NOC on turn-ups and maintenance’s
  • Performing maintenances
  • Maintaining inventory and updating records with new location of inventory
  • Updating records with up-to-date information on new installs and after maintenances of inventory and circuit information
  • Working with the NOC on the resolution of trouble tickets they are assigned and provide relevant and timely updates.
  • Troubleshooting and assistance with lower tier of Field engineering the NOC and customers on trouble tickets and new turn-ups
  • Ensure all equipment is in hand needed for any network installs or maintenances.
  • Review and comment on MOPs to ensure understanding of the work being performed and correctness of information in the MOP
  • Basic troubleshooting of HVAC systems
  • Installation of DC powered equipment
  • Providing OTDR shots to the NOC and engineering and troubleshooting of fiber breaks

Education, Training, Knowledge, Skills and Qualifications

  • Understanding of IP/Ethernet routing and switching
  • Familiarity with MPLS technologies
  • Familiarity with routing protocols
  • Configuring and troubleshooting Ethernet circuits (VLANs) on a service provider network
  • Advanced network trouble-shooting skills, including familiarity with Wireshark, RFC2544, y.1564 and use of other packet analysis tools
  • Advanced knowledge of Core, Distribution, and Access layer designs and topologies
  • Familiarity with best network security practices
  • Knowledge and experience with process management and improvement techniques
  • Ability to independently manage projects from order through implementation
  • Ability to interface with a larger team on major projects
  • Strong organizational, coordination, written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work independently as well as in a team environment
  • Strong people skills and the willingness to be accountable for results
  • Ability to set own priorities as well as manage time responsibly
  • Must have excellent customer relationship skills
  • Demonstrated knowledge and understanding of Passive Optical Network (PON) systems, including deployment, and basic troubleshooting.
  • Experience with one or more of the following vendors is highly desirable: ADVA, Nokia, Cisco, Juniper, and Cambium.

Working Conditions and Travel Requirements

  • Ability to perform maintenance work as scheduled at night or early morning
  • Available for On-call 24/7/365 - network outages and priority projects -Excludes scheduled PTO
  • Must be able to lift and carry up to 50+ pounds
  • Standard office environment
  • Employee’s desk must be adequate and designed to safely accommodate the equipment the employee must use, e.g. computer, printer, keyboard, monitor etc. and employee workstation must comply with NOANET’s ergonomics standards.
  • Employee must have reliable connectivity to the internet to access NOANET via VPN.

Years of Experience required to meet minimum qualifications

  • Five or more years of qualified experience

Level of Education required to meet minimum qualifications

  • High School diploma or equivalent required.
  • Associates’ degree in Telecommunications, Computer Science or related field required; OR a combination of relevant education and/or work experience sufficient to perform the duties may be substituted for the degree on a year-for-year basis.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to lift and carry up to 50 lbs. and work in cramped spaces and at heights.

  • Must pass background check.

  • Must maintain and possess a valid driver’s license, proof of insurance, and a satisfactory driving record.

Location

  • Must be a resident of Washington located in the Seattle area.

Salary

  • Salary range $75k-$105k DOE.

Benefits

  • Defined Benefit Retirement Plan through the WA State Department of Retirement Systems
  • 457b Optional Supplement Plan
  • Medical, Dental and Vision insurance
  • Accidental Death and Long Term Disability Plan
  • Combined Paid Leave
  • 11 Paid Holidays

Disclaimer: The above information on this description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, and responsibilities required of employees assigned to this job.
