data.description:
We are a team of marketing strategists, digital innovators, life science leaders, and other professionals who are driving growth, pushing the envelope, and going above and beyond on behalf of our clients every day.

PharmaForceIQ is a real-time customer engagement platform built specifically for life sciences. We empower leaders across functions and brands with a faster, more effective way to engage healthcare professionals and patients. By streamlining real-time optichannel execution, leveraging AI, and focusing on measurable impact, we are driving a paradigm shift from sluggish, siloed customer engagement efforts to agile, data-driven strategies that deliver unmatched efficiency and tangible results.

Position Overview:

We are seeking a hands-on Senior SRE / DevOps Engineer to design, operate, secure, and continuously improve highly available cloud platforms and delivery systems. The role combines production engineering, cloud operations, Kubernetes platform ownership, CI/CD automation, observability, incident management, and security operations. The successful candidate will own reliability outcomes across application and infrastructure services, reduce operational toil through automation, guide engineering teams on production readiness, and provide expert support for AWS and Amazon EKS. This is a senior individual-contributor role requiring strong technical judgment, disciplined operational practices, and the ability to lead during high-severity incidents.

  • Key Responsibilities:

Source Control & CI/CD Engineering

•Administer Bitbucket and GitLab repos, branching strategies, merge controls, and

release governance.

•Design and maintain Jenkins and GitLab CI/CD pipelines with reusable templates,
shared libraries, and environment promotion models.

•Integrate code-quality, security, container, and secret scanning into pipelines; eliminate
plaintext secrets via approved secret-management platforms.

•Enable safe deployment strategies (rolling, blue-green, canary) with automated
rollback; troubleshoot pipeline, runner, webhook, and dependency failures.

Cloud Operations & AWS Platform Management

•Own cloud environments end-to-end across dev, test, staging, and production: provisioning, patching, backup, recovery, and lifecycle management.

•Operate core AWS services (EC2, Auto Scaling, VPC, ELB, Lambda, Route 53, S3, EBS, IAM, KMS, RDS, EMR, CloudWatch, CloudTrail, Systems Manager) and design resilient multi-AZ network/compute patterns.

•Implement infrastructure as code via Terraform with a peer review, drift detection, and

reusable modules.

•Define and test backup, DR, and HA procedures with documented RTO/RPO; manage tagging, cost optimization, and patching cycles.

Containers, Docker & Amazon EKS

•Lead secure, optimized application Dockerization: multi-stage builds, minimal base images, non-root execution, registry practices.

•Design, provision, upgrade, and support production-grade EKS clusters, managed node groups, networking, ingress, and add-on lifecycle.

•Operate Kubernetes workloads (Deployments, Stateful Sets, Services, Ingress, Jobs, PodDisruptionBudgets) and deploy via Helm and GitOps.

•Implement EKS security controls (RBAC, IAM Roles for Service Accounts, network policies, least privilege); troubleshoot scheduling, networking, and autoscaling issues.

Logging, Monitoring & Observability

•Engineer centralized log management using Splunk and/or Datadog: collection, parsing, retention, dashboards, and alerting.

•Deploy and maintain Prometheus, Grafana, and Alertmanager for platform and application monitoring.

•Define SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, and availability targets; build role-specific dashboards for execs, ops, and engineers.

•Tune alerts to be actionable and severity-based, reducing noise; ensure every critical alert has an owner and runbook.

Reliability & Production Operations

•Participate in and improve the escalation paths.

•Lead major-incident response (triage, stabilization, communication, recovery) and drive blameless post-incident reviews.

•Maintain runbooks, SOPs, dependency maps, and production-readiness checklists; automate repetitive tasks via Python, Bash, and APIs.

•Perform capacity planning, resilience testing, and mentor engineers in troubleshooting and reliability practices.

Security Operations & Vulnerability Management

•Own vulnerability-management workflows across OS, containers, dependencies, cloud, Kubernetes, and CI/CD components.

•Coordinate VAPT: validate findings, assess impact, assign remediation owners, track SLAs, and provide closure evidence.

•Integrate SAST, DAST, dependency, container, IaC, and secret scanning into pipelines; apply hardening baselines.

•Support IAM reviews, key/certificate rotation, privileged-access controls, audit logging, and compliance/risk reporting.

  • Qualifications:
  • 10–12+ years in DevOps, SRE, cloud, platform, or production operations engineering, with 3+ years in a senior/lead capacity.
  • Demonstrated production ownership on AWS: EC2, VPC, load balancers, S3, RDS, EMR, CloudWatch, IAM.
  • Deep hands-on experience with Git, Bitbucket, GitLab, Jenkins, and GitLab CI/CD, including pipeline design, troubleshooting, and governance.
  • Expert-level Docker and Kubernetes experience, including building, operating, and upgrading Amazon EKS clusters and workloads.
  • Hands-on experience with Splunk, and Monitoring with Prometheus, Grafana, and Alert manager.
  • Practical infrastructure-as-code experience (Terraform, Helm) and strong Python/Bash automation skills.
  • Solid understanding of Linux administration, TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, HTTP, load balancing, IAM, storage, and distributed systems.
  • Experience with incident management, RCA, post-incident reviews, SLOs, capacity planning, and backup/recovery.
  • Experience managing vulnerabilities and VAPT findings and implementing security controls across cloud, container, OS, and delivery platforms.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, and calm decision-making under pressure across engineering, security, and business teams.

Why Join Us?

  • Enjoy the flexibility of a fully remote work environment.

  • Comprehensive health and wellness benefits package.

data.title: Principal ML Platform Engineer
data.description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

We’re looking for a Principal Engineer to join the ML Platform team at Synthesia.

Our team builds and operates the systems that allow researchers and product teams to train, serve, and deploy generative models reliably and efficiently. This includes research infrastructure, production serving systems, internal tooling, and the platform interfaces that connect them. A growing part of our mission is making these systems more automation-friendly and agent-oriented, so that workflows can increasingly be operated through reliable tooling rather than manual effort.

We’re looking for a strong generalist with a systems mindset:

  • someone who is comfortable working across infrastructure, backend systems, and tooling, and who has seen ML systems in practice.

  • this is not a pure ML Engineer role. We’re especially interested in people who think deeply about reliability, scalability, performance, and resource efficiency in complex production environments.

This is a hands-on IC role with significant ownership. You’ll help shape how our ML platform evolves as we scale the number of models, workloads, tools and teams relying on it.

What you’ll do

  • Design and improve the platform systems that support model training, evaluation, and production serving.

  • Build infrastructure and tooling that make ML workloads more reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient.

  • Develop internal tools and workflows that are easy to operate both by humans and by agents.

  • Work on the architecture behind how models are deployed, served, and operated across research and product environments.

  • Improve how we schedule, monitor, and debug workloads running on GPUs and cloud infrastructure.

  • Develop internal tools and abstractions and agentic systems that reduce operational overhead for researchers and engineers.

  • Drive improvements across observability, automation, reliability, and developer experience.

  • Collaborate closely with researchers and product engineers to understand pain points and turn them into robust platform capabilities.

  • Contribute to technical direction and make pragmatic architectural tradeoffs as the platform grows.

You’ll thrive in this role if you have

  • Strong experience building or operating production systems with a focus on reliability, scalability, and maintainability.

  • A systems mindset: you naturally think in terms of bottlenecks, failure modes, interfaces, resource usage, and long-term operability.

  • Solid hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure, Linux, and infrastructure automation.

  • Experience with Kubernetes and operating distributed workloads in production.

  • Strong coding skills, ideally in Python or similar languages used for backend systems and tooling.

  • Strong judgment around where automation adds leverage, and where human control and reliability matter most.

  • Experience building internal platforms, developer tooling, or infrastructure abstractions used by other engineers.

  • Comfort working in ambiguous environments and taking ownership of open-ended technical problems.

  • A pragmatic approach: you care about solving the right problem well, not over-engineering.

Particularly relevant experience

  • Operating ML infrastructure or model serving systems in production.

  • Supporting research or data-intensive workloads.

  • Working with GPU-based systems or other performance-sensitive infrastructure.

  • Experience with observability and debugging in distributed systems.

  • Familiarity with Terraform, Datadog, GitHub Actions, or similar tools.

Bonus points for

  • Experience building agentic or LLM-powered internal tools.

  • Experience with workflow orchestration systems such as Temporal.

  • Experience working at the boundary between research and production engineering.

  • Familiarity with performance optimization, scheduling, or resource allocation problems.

  • Experience building lightweight product or developer-facing tools.

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: PLM Solutions Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary

We are seeking a PLM Platform Engineer with deep experience operating either PTC Windchill or Siemens Teamcenter (preferably both) in large enterprise environments. In this role you will own the technical operation of the PLM platform — installation, configuration, performance tuning, upgrades, integrations, and high availability — and partner with functional, engineering, and manufacturing teams to deliver a reliable, performant, and secure PLM ecosystem. The ideal candidate will bring strong PLM administration fundamentals, hands-on experience with PLM upgrades and migrations, and a measurement-driven approach to platform reliability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Install, configure, and operate Windchill or Teamcenter environments across development, test, and production.
  • Lead PLM upgrades, patches, and platform migrations with minimal disruption.
  • Manage PLM application servers, web servers, database connectivity, and method servers.
  • Operate file vaults, replication services, and CAD data management subsystems.
  • Implement and tune HA/DR strategies for PLM environments, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.
  • Optimize PLM performance through query tuning, caching, indexing, and JVM tuning.
  • Manage user provisioning, security configurations, and audit support, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.
  • Operate PLM integration brokers and middleware connectors, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.
  • Develop automation scripts using shell, Python, or Ansible to reduce operational toil.
  • Monitor PLM health using native tooling and integrated observability platforms.
  • Provide hands-on post-go-live and hypercare support, working closely with operations teams to triage incidents quickly, identify root causes, and drive durable fixes that improve long-term system stability.
  • Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.
  • Mentor and coach junior and mid-level engineers through code review, design review, pair programming, and structured knowledge sharing, helping the broader team grow in technical maturity and confidence over time.
  • Drive continuous improvement of the PLM platform, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of PLM platform administration experience.
  • Hands-on experience with either PTC Windchill or Siemens Teamcenter in production.
  • Strong experience with PLM upgrades and migrations.
  • Working knowledge of Oracle and SQL Server database administration.
  • Strong Linux/Unix administration skills.
  • Experience operating HA/DR for PLM environments.
  • Familiarity with PLM integration brokers and middleware.
  • Scripting skills in shell, Python, or Ansible.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and documentation skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience operating PLM on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, OCI).
  • Exposure to infrastructure-as-code for PLM environments.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD patterns for PLM change management.
  • PTC or Siemens PLM certifications.
  • Experience with CAD integration patterns at scale.


How to Apply

data.description:
Unlock the secrets of intelligence with MANTECH! Join a dynamic team at the forefront of national security, providing advanced solutions to government intelligence agencies. Since 1968, we’ve been solving the toughest challenges with groundbreaking tech. Explore thrilling projects in Digital Transformation, Cybersecurity, IT, Data Analytics and Software Development. Elevate your career and make a difference. Your adventure begins now—unleash your potential with MANTECH!

MANTECH is looking for a highly motivated and qualified CNO Cloud Engineer to join our team in a remote based position.  This rewarding and challenging position supports the Department of War (DoW) to produce a wide range of capabilities to improve cyberspace operations and defend U.S. vital national security interests.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Provide CNO Cloud-based Solutions: Implement AWS services to provide a CNO command and control (C2) hub for provisioning warfighters' cyber hardware and software resources.
  • Drive CNO Cloud Security & Compliance Automation: Build, maintain, and automate recurring STIG/CIS/NSA compliance scan pipelines, OpenSCAP/Kubescape security scanning workflows, and Security Hub findings normalization across multi-environment CNO AWS infrastructure (Dev/Stage/Prod).
  • Manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & Golden Image Pipelines: Develop and maintain Terraform templates, Golden AMI/Image Builder pipelines, AWS KMS key configurations, network/firewall integration, and Kubernetes (EKS/Big Bang) deployment scaling.
  • Integrate Software: Implement Application Programming Interface (API) workflows and develop APIs for secure intercommunication of technologies
  • Technical Onboarding, Architecture & Cross-Team Coordination: Author comprehensive system architecture diagrams and Confluence technical documentation; serve as the technical liaison between Information Assurance (IA), security stakeholders, and internal DevOps engineers.

Required Qualifications:

  • Education and Experience: Bachelor’s degree in related field with 4yrs of relevant (or High School Diploma with 8 years of relevant experience)
  • Core AWS & Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Expertise: 5+ years of hands-on experience with AWS cloud services (EC2, S3, Security Hub, KMS, networking/firewalls), Terraform, and cost optimization across multi-account/multi-environment architectures.
  • DevSecOps, STIG & Security Compliance Automation: Demonstrated experience implementing automated security
  • compliance (DISA STIGs, CIS Benchmarks, NSA frameworks) using tools like OpenSCAP, Kubescape, or AWS Security Hub within DoD/federal environments.
  • Kubernetes, CI/CD & Systems Architecture: Proficiency with Kubernetes cluster management, container image pipelines (AMI Builder/GitLab CI), peer code reviews (MRs), and writing high-level architectural decision records (ADRs) and system documentation.
  • Ability to travel to San Antonio, TX area up to 25% for meetings, as need

Desired Qualifications:

  • AWS certification
  • Kubernetes certification
  • Familiarity with Gov Cloud environments
  • Familiarity with SIEM and SOAR technologies
  • Familiarity with DoD Enterprise DevSecOps Reference Design
  • Familiarity with CNO infrastructure support to CNO operations

Security clearance requirement:

  • US citizenship required
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain TS/SCI clearance

Physical requirements:

  • Must be able to be in a stationary position more than 50% of the time
  • Must be able to communicate, converse, and exchange information with peers and senior personnel
  • Constantly operates a computer and other office productivity machinery, such as a computer


The projected compensation range for this position is $94,800.00-$157,200.00. There are differentiating factors that can impact a final salary/hourly rate, including, but not limited to, Contract Wage Determination, relevant work experience, skills and competencies that align to the specified role, geographic location (For Remote Opportunities), education and certifications as well as Federal Government Contract Labor categories. In addition, MANTECH invests in its employees beyond just compensation. MANTECH’s benefits offerings include, dependent upon position, Health Insurance, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, Holiday Pay, short-term and long-term Disability, Retirement and Savings, Learning and Development opportunities, wellness programs as well as other optional benefit elections.


MANTECH considers all qualified applicants for employment without regard to disability or veteran status or any other status protected under any federal, state, or local law or regulation.

If you need a reasonable accommodation to apply for a position with MANTECH, please email us at and provide your name and contact information.

data.title: Network Engineer
data.description:
Introduction

The Network Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, operating and maintaining the customer infrastructure (Banking and MFI) and wide area networks. Plus, he/she builds relationships and work with telecom service and maintenance vendors. The Network Engineer should ensure network devices are at the latest or most advanced stage of development, innovation and pioneering in cutting-edge network technology and monitoring the issues. At any moment, the Network Engineer could be asked to participate in tasks that are assigned by a senior network engineer.

Jos Responsibilities:

  • Install and configure network devices such as Cisco Switch/Router, Unify Access Point, Checkpoint/Fortigate/PaloAlto Firewall, TCP/IP & Wireless Connection.
  • Ensure availability connectivity of Data Center to DR Site and to any other branch/POS
  • Installation, and support of network communications including LAN/WAN systems, T1, SIP, and VOIP systems.
  • Upgrade network equipment and all network system to latest stable firmware/patch releases.
  • Monitoring Inbound/Outbound of network traffic, ensure all users access internet under security prohibition.
  • Ensure that network performance, recovery, and security configuration are meet with security recommendation.
  • Investigate, diagnoses and troubleshoot network related problems.
  • Monitors the network for problem conditions, implements network troubleshooting procedures to isolate specific problem source and take corrective action
  • Provide Second Level Support of network issue and working closely with Helpdesk team in resolving issue.
  • Ensure ticket of request support are fixed following SLA and keep update status to Helpdesk team or User regularly.
  • Communicate and facilitate with other department for any incident of notification require.
  • Day to day technical operation activities and support to the customer request support.
  • Ensure whole network quality, healthy, security and high performance
  • Other task as assign from time to time by Senior Infrastructure Engineer
  • Tracking on product renewal report, patches.
  • Generate monthly report related bandwidth throughputs.

Jos Requirement:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or Engineering or related field.
  • A strong practical skill or experience of installation and configuration of Firewall, Network Devices such as Cisco, Fortigate, Checkpoint and Unify.
  • 2 years’ equivalent work experience in a position related to network design for large companies.
  • Cisco certifications (CCNA, CCDA, CCNP, etc.) and experience of Fortigate Firewall are recommended.
  • Knowledge of TCP/IP communications and how common protocols and applications work at the network level, including DNS, HTTP.
  • Solid understanding of computer network fundamentals including address resolution protocol (ARP), routing, network address translation, virtual private networks, and the OSI model
  • Fluent in English both spoken and written is mandatory. Fluency in Khmer is a must.
  • Must be self-starter, able to work independently and deliver according to expectation.
  • Willing to learn, self-improve and “Can do” attitude.
  • Availability for third level 24 x 7 On-Call Support
  • Be able to work with under pressure environment.

data.description:
This is a remote position.

Senior System Administrator (IT Infrastructure and Security)Remote (India) | Full-Time Also searched as: Senior Systems Engineer, IT Infrastructure Engineer, L3 Support Engineer, IT Security Engineer

If you were handed admin rights to every system a 425-person company runs on, what would you harden first?

On a typical day you might take an escalation off the systems engineer in the morning and turn its root cause into a runbook they can run next time, walk the MSP through a segmentation change on a Melbourne campus network after lunch, and end the day confirming with the People team that a leaver's access is actually gone.

About Contour

We started in 2020 with a handful of students and a belief that great education should not be out of reach. Today we operate across three brands with 8,000+ students and 425+ team members: roughly 100 in India and 325 onshore in Australia. The India team runs publishing, student experience, CRM and technology, operations, and people and culture.

The people we hire now will shape how Contour grows. This is one of those roles.

About This Role

You are the senior engineer in Contour's first in-house IT team, and the escalation point above it. You run the systems the company works in: Google Workspace, Slack, HubSpot, Rippling and the LMS; the identity platform and the device fleet; the network, CCTV and door access at each campus; and the security posture across all of it.

You report to the interim IT lead in Melbourne until the handover is complete, then to the VP of Global Enablement and Support. They own the technology budget, vendor contracts and the call on which platforms we standardise on. Risk acceptance sits with the senior leadership team. Everything else is yours: the design, the configuration, the hardening, and the no when a vendor does not pass your review.

Expect roughly two thirds of your week on system ownership, hardening and project work, and one third on escalations. The team is you and a systems engineer who runs the L1 and L2 queue. You mentor them and review their work, but this is a hands-on-keyboard seat. Leading the team as it grows is open to you if you want it: welcome, not required.

The standard here is different in two ways. First, you fix the cause. An escalation you close carries a root cause and, if it has come up before, a runbook. Second, you hold the line on security and can explain why. You have said no to something convenient because it was not safe, and you can walk a non-technical executive through that trade-off without dumbing it down or hiding behind acronyms.

Contour has grown to three brands and two countries on systems that were administered alongside other jobs. The interim IT lead has spent the past few months setting the security baseline and documenting it. You take that handover and make it permanent, then build what comes after: identity done properly, a managed fleet, campuses you can see and control from India, and a change process people trust.

By the end of month three, you will have MFA and 2SV at full coverage, a first access review done, and offboarding revocation confirmed rather than assumed. You will have a change record on every production change, the top repeat escalations written into runbooks and handed to the systems engineer, the findings from our recent security review triaged into a dated remediation plan with the first fixes shipped, and the UniFi stack documented for each campus with SPF, DKIM and DMARC enforced on the domain. The controls you put in place in those first months will still be holding when the company is twice this size.

Where the Work Lives

  • Google Workspace:the identity core for staff and where most of the business's data sits. Admin console settings here are security settings: group-driven access, external sharing rules, and audit logs someone reads.
  • Slack:where the company talks and where tickets arrive. Most of what you decide gets explained here, to people who do not administer anything.
  • Rippling and the identity platform:Rippling is the HR system of record, and we are choosing a dedicated identity and device management platform now. Joiner, mover and leaver flows start in Rippling and end with confirmed access, or confirmed revocation, in every system downstream. You inherit the platform decision and run the rollout across a largely BYOD fleet of several hundred macOS and Windows devices.
  • HubSpot and the LMS:the CRM and our own learning platform. Sales, tutors and students work in them, so admin rights, integrations and data flow here protect student data as much as they serve the teams using them.
  • UniFi:the network at each campus, managed from one controller with alerts you cannot ignore. Segmentation, firmware and capacity discipline here are what keep a campus network boring.
  • 1Password:the enterprise password manager. Shared credentials get retired into it, and break-glass accounts are documented, sealed and tested.
  • Suptask:tickets come in through Slack. Each escalation you close records why it happened, so the trend report means something.
  • ​Make.com and Zapier:the automation layer. A scenario that fails silently is worse than the manual step it replaced, so alerting is part of the build.

What You Will Do

  • Take the L2 and L3 escalations and stop them coming back.Close what the systems engineer cannot, record the cause, then write the runbook so that ticket type is theirs from then on.Design identity and access.Role-based access, group-driven permissions, SSO where it is available, MFA and 2SV at full coverage. Run the periodic access review and own the technical side of offboarding.
  • Administer the workplace stack at senior level.The platforms above plus the approved AI platforms, device management across macOS and Windows, and the systems that finance, sales and tutors work in: hardening, admin rights, audit logging, licence use, and the integrations and data flow between them.
  • Run the campus networks, CCTV and door access from India.UniFi design, segmentation, firmware and capacity at each campus; CCTV retention and who can view footage; door access rules and their link to the identity platform. The MSP provides hands on site: you set the scope, run the escalation path, and hold them to their service commitments.
  • Own the security posture end to end.Endpoint security (disk encryption, patch levels, endpoint protection, compliance reporting on the fleet), email and domain security (phishing defence, conditional access, SPF, DKIM and DMARC), credential hygiene through 1Password and break-glass handling, and a security assessment of any new system or vendor before we adopt it. When the answer is no, say no.
  • Lead incident response for security incidents and outages alike.Contain, investigate, keep the timeline, write the RCA with what changed as a result. Close out the findings from our recent security review and keep the remediation on schedule.
  • Put a change record in front of anything touching production.Approver, rollback and verification step, with no exceptions. It exists so the next engineer can see what was done and why.
  • Write it down for whoever inherits it.System references for everything you administer, and guides that make sense to someone who was not there when it was built.
  • Report to the leadership team in plain terms.Ticket trends, availability, licence use and the seats nobody touches; security posture with the cost of fixing something and the cost of leaving it. Bring recommendations with the risk and the alternative you rejected.
  • Build automations that tell you when they break.Make.com or Zapier scenarios with error handling and alerting; the happy path is the easy part. Lead practical AI use across the team: where it helps, where it does not belong, and what it saves.
  • Mentor the systems engineer.Review their tickets, coach the diagnosis, correct habits early. Hiring stays with the IT lead for now.

HubSpot is fixed. Everything else is open: if a better tool exists for something we are doing manually, make the case and we will back it.

Requirements

What You Need

  • Four or more years in systems administration, systems engineering or senior IT support, including at least two years as the accountable administrator for a core business system: the person who decided how it was configured, and the person paged when it broke.
  • Administrator-level Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 at a few hundred users or more. We run Google Workspace, so if your depth is Microsoft 365, show us the concepts carry across.
  • Identity and access as a design discipline: SSO, MFA, an identity provider, and least privilege applied by default.
  • Security you owned, with evidence: hardening, access reviews, patching, endpoint protection, and at least one security incident you handled from detection to write-up.
  • Networking you can diagnose remotely: VLANs, routing, wireless design, and hands-on UniFi or comparable. The campuses are in Australia and you are in India, so working from the controller before you send someone on site is the job.
  • Endpoint management across macOS and Windows at fleet scale, including devices the company does not own.
  • A change process you have followed for real, including at least one change you rolled back cleanly.
  • Scripting to a useful standard: Python, JavaScript or Google Apps Script, and the habit of reading an API reference before asking.
  • Plain English for executives. The leadership team funds what it understands, so a trade-off you cannot explain without acronyms is a fix that does not get approved.
  • ​Comfortable working across the India and Australia time difference; the team you support sits in Melbourne.

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on UniFi, CCTV or door access control work
  • HubSpot, Rippling, Aircall or Notion administration
  • Light scripting or automation: Google Apps Script, Zapier or Make.com scenarios, or basic Python
  • Time in education or another environment that handles student or minor data
  • A diploma, degree or certification in the field: CompTIA A+ or Network+, Microsoft 365 Fundamentals, Google Workspace Administrator

The Kind of People Who​ Thrive Here

The people who do well here see a gap and close it without being asked, holding the bar even when the clock is short. They give a direct read on the work in front of them, including when it's wrong, and when their own idea doesn't hold up, they say so and bring a better one. They build something that keeps running after they step back. Problems here don't show up on schedule or in the same shape twice, and they'd rather make the right call on limited information than let something break while they wait for a sign-off. That's the job. They name the blocker and the ask the moment they have it, on a call or a text, because decisions get made on the information you bring.

Contour's current cluster heads started as team leads. The path from operator to leader is real here.

What good looks like

  • Fast first, then thorough: every ticket gets a quick first response and a fix that holds, in that order.
  • Closed means confirmed: a ticket closes when the person who raised it says it works.
  • Escalations carry evidence: what you tried, what you saw, what you ruled out, so the senior engineer starts where you stopped.
  • Offboarding leaves nothing behind: a leaver's access is gone on the day, with a name against every step.
  • Repeat work shrinks: the queue gets lighter over the year because recurring tickets get automated or documented out of it.

Benefits

Fully remote, anywhere in India. No travel: the campus hardware is in Melbourne and you work it through the MSP and the onshore team. Compensation details shared early in the hiring process. You will hear from us within a week of applying, and the process is a written screen, a short video response, a practical task, and two conversations.

Apply with a CV and one paragraph on a request you slowed down, scoped down or refused because it was not safe, and what happened next.

data.description:
Our US Partner is seeking a reliable and detail-oriented E-Commerce Platform Specialist to own the day-to-day operation of their e-commerce platform portfolio. The ideal candidate will manage a proprietary branded store platform built in-house, as well as a third-party enterprise e-commerce platform used for complex client deployments.

This role requires strong technical execution, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate effectively with internal teams, sales departments, and enterprise clients. You will spend most of your time inside the platforms building, configuring, and troubleshooting configurations independently.

This is a full-time role, on a US shift and on a Work From Home set-up.

If you have the right skill set, this may be your opportunity to enter this fast-growing organization.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Platform Operations (70%)

  • Build, configure, and launch branded client stores on both internal and external e-commerce platforms.

  • Handle HTML, CSS, and basic JavaScript customizations independently, without escalating to the development team.

  • Configure products, categories, pricing, access rules, approval workflows, and checkout settings per client.

  • Manage Single Sign-On (SSO) integrations with client identity providers, including Azure AD.

  • Maintain and monitor integrations with warehouse, fulfillment, and ERP systems.

  • Troubleshoot platform issues, isolate root causes, and resolve or escalate them efficiently.

  • Use Git for version control when working on the internal platform codebase.

  • Keep platform records current, including store specifications, configuration decisions, and onboarding runbooks.

Client and Sales Support (20%)

  • Serve as the operational point of contact for active store clients, handling configuration requests, asset updates, and reporting.

  • Work alongside the sales team to scope new store requirements before commitments are made to a client.

  • Translate client briefs into concrete platform configurations, flagging what is native, what needs custom work, and what is out of scope.

  • Support store launches end-to-end, covering requirements gathering, building, QA, and final go-live execution.

Roadmap and Migrations (10%)

  • Feed the internal platform roadmap with client and operational requirements, working closely with the Head of Technology and front-end developers.

  • Plan and execute migrations of existing client stores from legacy platforms like Magento and Shopify onto the current platform stack.

  • Inventory existing store configurations, product catalogs, and integrations before initiating migrations.

  • Manage content and data transfers, re-platforming workflows seamlessly where necessary.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required Experience & Technical Skills

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience operating or building e-commerce stores across multiple platforms.

  • Direct experience with Magento (Open Source or Commerce) and Shopify, including configuration, theming, product setup, and migrations.

  • Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and basic JavaScript with the ability to make layout, styling, and functional changes independently.

  • Comfortable utilizing Git for version control at a basic operational level.

  • Proven experience configuring SSO integrations (Azure AD / SAML 2.0).

  • Deep understanding of e-commerce platform architecture, including routing, templates, product catalogs, variants, and checkout flows.

  • Ability to read and interpret code well enough to debug without always relying on a developer.

  • Conceptual understanding of integrations (APIs, webhooks, and system connectivity) without needing to build them from scratch.

Professional & Behavioral Skills

  • Strong operational instincts with a proactive, can-do attitude—you close loops, document actions, and do not need to be chased.

  • Comfortable working directly and professionally with enterprise clients and sales teams.

  • A "finisher" mindset: able to take a store brief and take it live without constant escalation, spotting platform gaps early.

  • Commercial awareness to know when to push back on requirements that are structurally unfeasible.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and configurations in a fast-paced environment.

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience with company store or branded merchandise platforms (such as Liftoff Commerce, BrightStores, or similar).

  • Familiarity with warehouse or fulfillment integrations (ShipStation, Extensiv, or similar).

  • Exposure to NetSuite or another major ERP in an e-commerce context.

  • Prior experience in the promotional products or branded merchandise industry.

Apply directly on RemoteJobs.org: https://remotejobs.org/remote-jobs/e-commerce-platform-specialist-tahche-outsourcing-services-inc

data.title: Senior Network Engineer (Wireless)
data.description:
About Us

We are a global climate technologies company engineered for sustainability. We create sustainable and efficient residential, commercial and industrial spaces through HVACR technologies. We protect temperature-sensitive goods throughout the cold chain. And we bring comfort to people globally. Best-in-class engineering, design and manufacturing combined with category-leading brands in compression, controls, software and monitoring solutions result in next-generation climate technology that is built for the needs of the world ahead. 

Whether you are a professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring your first opportunity, or recent graduate with an advanced degree, we have opportunities that will allow you to innovate, be challenged and make an impact. Join our team and start your journey today!

Description

Provides engineering leadership and design guidance in support of the Copeland Enterprise Global network. Candidate will lead the wireless architecture design and operations development workstream for Copelands global wireless solution. Candidate will be the senior technical resource for all things RF and Wi-Fi and will mentor the operations resources in best practices for supporting the Wi-Fi infrastructure. The Senior Network Engineer will have a strong and broad level of knowledge around all things IT Networking to include Routing, Switching, Firewalls, Cisco ISE, Cisco DNAC, Cisco IQ, and Cisco Cloud Center. The Senior Network Engineer / Architect will provide Level IV operational support for the IT Enterprise and provide guidance in the resolution of chronic and complex anomalies specific to the Wi-Fi deployment at Copeland. The Senior Network Engineer / Architect works under the direction of the Senior Manager, Network Engineering of Network Services.

As the Senior Network Engineer, you will:

  • Plans, designs, and implements network infrastructure technologies with a focus on wireless technologies, also including LAN, SD-WAN, Firewalls, and any other network systems
  • Supports infrastructure operations as a Level IV technical resource and provides technical leadership and mentoring to the operations group
  • Researches and evaluates emerging network and communication technology
  • Provides leadership and technical guidance as an SME for the Enterprise IT communications
  • Works with Security and Cloud Infrastructure groups as an SME for Enterprise IT Communications
  • Assists with the evaluation of new and emerging technologies· Support development and maintenance of scripts to facilitate network administrative tasks and automate repetitive processes· Lead the evaluation of new hardware, firmware, and software· Tests and develops procedural documentation and training for others on installation and support
  • Maintains vendor relationships for support as needed
  • Identifies training needs, coordinates training, and participates in the development of training materials
  • Monitors network performance and implements performance tuning
  • Performs root cause analysis of problems and tracks, documents and reports identified patterns
  • Provide proactive recognition and correction of network related problems
  • Provide support to customers and staff during new WAN or datacenter installations
  • Provide the coordination of repair and restoral efforts of various service providers, including monitoring services, telecommunication providers and ISPs
  • Work with various customer and Enterprise IT support groups in diagnosing network service-related problems

Required education, experiences & skills:

  • Fifteen or more years working hands on with routing and switching devices
  • Minimum of 10 years’ recent experience in the design, implementation, and operation of WAN/LAN and Wireless networks with Cisco hardware utilizing Cisco tools (Catalyst Center, ISE, Prime)
  • Detailed understanding of the function and configuration of Cisco Wireless networking solutions
  • Advance experience configuring and troubleshooting of global large Wireless network infrastructure utilizing remote access, SolarWinds, Cisco ISE, Cisco Prime, Cisco Catalyst Center
  • Operational knowledge of VLANs, spanning tree, BGP, EIGRP, OSPF
  • Functional understanding of SDWAN and related technologies required
  • Understands the Digital organization’s objectives, and impact on own projects; contributes to development of new technology integration and enablement plans
  • Ability to comprehend and create complex network maps and drawings in standard design tools (i.e. Visio)
  • Functional understanding of DNS, DHCP and related network services
  • Understanding of IP addressing including subnetting and supernetting
  • Ability to perform maintenance activities outside of normal business hours
  • Bachelor’s degree in CS, MIS or related technology/engineering discipline preferred or equivalent experience required
  • Cisco CCNP Enterprise Professional (CCNP Enterprise) certification
  • Equivalent 5 years military experience in an IT Network Military Occupational Specialty (MOS) is also acceptable

Preferred education, experiences & skills:

  • Cisco Certified Internet Expert (CCIE) certification preferred

Why Work in St. Louis, Missouri

Our facility is located in St. Louis, famous for its Gateway Arch standing at 630 feet tall. St. Louis is a family-friendly, historic metropolitan area with a low cost of living and first-class schools. The city offers excellent restaurants, shopping areas, art galleries, and numerous festivals throughout the year, making this an exciting place to live and work.

About Our Location

Our location is the host of Copeland’s corporate headquarters. Our products have become household names that support the comfort and well-being of our customers. The employees at this location provide support to the various businesses within the platform, allowing for many networking opportunities across businesses.

Remote Work Arrangement:

This role is fully remote. As a remote colleague, you may be required to travel to a Copeland site regularly to collaborate with your team or customers as needed. Copeland is committed to fostering a productive and connected culture, so you will have the opportunity to work with your team and leader to understand your team operating principles to collaborate effectively.

Our Commitment to Our People

Across the globe, we are united by a singular Purpose: Sustainability is no small ambition. That’s why everything we do is geared toward a sustainable future—for our generation and all those to come. Through groundbreaking innovations, HVACR technology and cold chain solutions, we are reducing carbon emissions and improving energy efficiency in spaces of all sizes, from residential to commercial to industrial.

Our employees are our greatest strength. We believe that our culture of passion, openness, and collaboration empowers us to work toward the same goal - to make the world a better place. We invest in the end-to-end development of our people, beginning at onboarding and through senior leadership, so they can thrive personally and professionally.

Flexible and competitive benefits plans offer the right options to meet your individual/family needs: medical insurance plans, dental and vision coverage, 401(k) and more. We provide employees with flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave, vacation and holiday leave. 

Together, we have the opportunity – and the power – to continue to revolutionize the technology behind air conditioning, heating and refrigeration, and cultivate a better future. Learn more about us and how you can join our team!

Our Commitment to Inclusion & Belonging

At Copeland, we cultivate a strong sense of inclusion and belonging where individuals of all backgrounds, and with diverse perspectives, are embraced and treated fairly to enable a stronger workforce. Our employee resource groups play an important role in culture and community building at Copeland.

Work Authorization

Copeland will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States. This is not a position for which sponsorship will be provided. Individuals with temporary visas such as E, F-1 with OPT or CPT, H-1, H-2, L-1, B, J or TN, or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible for hire.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Copeland is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, national origin, age, marital status, political affiliation, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. We are committed to providing a workplace free of any discrimination or harassment.

If you have a disability and are having difficulty accessing or using this website to apply for a position, please contact:

Location: Remote — South Asia (Open to applicants located anywhere in South Asia, with a preference for those based in IST or PKT time zones)

Fueled is a leading digital strategy, design, and engineering agency. We are a 300+ person team that has designed and built hundreds of digital products and experiences for brands like Google, Apple, The New York Times, ESPN, Victoria’s Secret, MGM Resorts, Albertsons, and CLEAR.

As a Senior Systems Engineer at Fueled, you will join a team designing, deploying, and operating robust, scalable infrastructure platforms that support everything from small workloads to enterprise-scale client environments. You will bring deep expertise in modern infrastructure as code — Terraform, Ansible, Helm, and CDK — and an automation-first mindset to every layer of the stack.

You will architect and automate scalable cloud environments across AWS and Azure (with GCP and Oracle Cloud a plus), drive seamless CI/CD, and shape infrastructure through containerization and orchestration. With strong Linux fundamentals, you'll handle everything from bare-metal tuning to cloud-native service monitoring, debugging complex distributed systems, and producing the comprehensive documentation that keeps high-uptime platforms running.

Intentionally remote and globally distributed across six continents, our team thrives in a culture that values flexibility, creativity, and cutting-edge technology. Together, we’re shaping the future of digital experiences.

What you will do:

  • Own cloud infrastructure end-to-end: You will architect, deploy, and manage highly available environments across AWS and Azure using Terraform, Ansible, Helm, and CDK, and lead production Kubernetes workloads in EKS/AKS — including upgrades, networking, and autoscaling.
  • Serve as the Linux subject matter expert: You will own system builds, configure and troubleshoot core services like NGINX, MariaDB, and Redis, and drive performance, security, and reliability from the kernel up.
  • Operate the data and caching tier: You will run and scale MariaDB/Galera clusters alongside Redis, Memcached, and Elasticsearch, applying performance tuning and IaC-driven workflows to keep everything fast and resilient.
  • Engineer CI/CD and automation: You will build and tune pipelines in GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, and Azure DevOps, and replace repetitive operational work with robust Python and Bash scripting that accelerates developer velocity.
  • Lead observability, security, and performance: You will evolve monitoring across metrics, logs, and traces, harden infrastructure security, participate in incident response and the 24/7 on-call rotation, and lead load-testing efforts that drive measurable platform improvements.

What you will achieve:

  • Week 1: You will seamlessly integrate with our engineering teams, auditing existing AWS/Azure architectures and CI/CD pipelines to understand our baseline operations and client workloads.
  • Month 1: You will be assisting with the 24/7 support on-call rotation and take ownership of core infrastructure deployments, standardize IaC practices, and begin tuning our Kubernetes clusters and Linux systems for optimal performance.
  • Month 6: You will have fully optimized and automated key deployment workflows, established highly available data tiers, and driven measurable improvements in security, observability, and overall platform reliability.
  • Team Impact: You will act as a critical bridge between systems and application teams, establishing robust platform engineering standards that support complex client workloads, including high-scale, highly available WordPress and headless setups.
  • Career Growth: You will establish yourself as a vital DevOps leader within the agency, shaping our multi-cloud strategy, heavily influencing infrastructure design, and elevating the technical standards of our operations.

About you:

  • You are a senior cloud infrastructure operator. You bring demonstrated senior-level experience in platform engineering or DevOps at scale or in multi-tenant environments, with strong hands-on AWS and Azure (multi-cloud preferred; GCP and Oracle Cloud a plus).
  • You are a Linux and IaC expert. You can set up, tune, troubleshoot, and harden Linux systems at a deep level, and you've taken Terraform, Ansible, Helm, or CDK projects from greenfield through long-term management.
  • You run production Kubernetes and data services. You have proven experience operating EKS/AKS — upgrades, networking, troubleshooting, Kubernetes PodWeaver — and managing production-grade NGINX, MariaDB/Galera, Redis/Memcached, and Elasticsearch.
  • You automate relentlessly and ship pipelines that scale. You write advanced Python and/or Bash, and you've built and tuned CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions, GitLab, or similar tools with a strong grasp of modern observability tooling and security best practices.
  • You communicate clearly and show up for the team. You write excellent documentation, work well with clients, bridge systems and application teams (including high-scale, highly available WordPress hosting and headless setups), and are available for a 24/7 support rotation.

Benefits & Salary

We offer competitive salaries and benefits. Compensation is determined based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, other job-related qualifications, geographic location, and business needs.

Join our Team

If you are passionate about Fueled's mission and think you have what it takes to be successful in this role, please apply. We'd appreciate the opportunity to review your application. Everyone gets a response.

Any data provided will be processed in accordance with applicable law and our privacy policy. Curious about what to expect during our talent process? Check it out here.

Join EVOTEK: North America’s Premier Digital Business Enabler

The Platform Architect will serve as a client-facing technical strategist and solution designer, responsible for architecting complex enterprise solutions. This role combines deep technical expertise with strong pre-sales and consultative skills to elicit requirements, drive solution design, align to business objectives, build customer confidence, and position successful delivery.

Role Summary

  • Drive pre-sales activities in collaboration with sales teams to perform technical discovery, identify client needs, and craft detailed solution designs and proposals.
  • Build and maintain independent relationships with clients and prospects.
  • Design and present architectures for on-prem, cloud, or hybrid solutions involving domain expertise in infrastructure, data, and AI.
  • Develop scalable virtualization and containerization strategies to support modernization and multi-cloud deployments.
  • Integrate data management, analytics, and AI/ML capabilities into platform architectures to drive business outcomes.
  • Lead technical presentations and demonstrations to customers, clearly articulating the value of proposed solutions.
  • Evaluate and recommend hardware and software technologies, leveraging vendor relationships to shape optimal solutions.
  • Support proposal development, RFP responses, and pricing strategies from an architectural perspective.
  • Provide technical assurance during implementation and handoff to delivery teams, ensuring design integrity.
  • Produce architecture documentation, high-level designs, and bill of materials.
  • Stay current with emerging technology trends in infrastructure, cloud, data, and AI to guide clients toward innovative solutions.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in enterprise architecture, systems integration, or platform engineering.
  • Proven track record in pre-sales architecture or technical consulting within a systems integrator or vendor environment.
  • Expertise in on-prem infrastructure architecture (compute, storage, networking) and leading cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Strong proficiency in virtualization (VMware, Hyper-V) and container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift).
  • Experience designing and integrating data platforms, analytics tools, and AI/ML frameworks into enterprise systems.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and customer engagement skills with the ability to influence technical and executive audiences.
  • Certifications in relevant technologies such as AWS Solutions Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, VMware Certified Design Expert, or Kubernetes certifications are highly advantageous.
  • Understanding of enterprise security principles, compliance requirements, and solution governance.

Benefits

  • Salary commensurate with years’ of experience, technical expertise and geographic location.
  • Salary range: $170,000 to $220,000.
  • Performance bonuses.
  • Benefits package that includes 100% paid medical, dental and vision for the employee.
  • 401(k) with employer match.
  • Strong company culture.
  • Flexible PTO policy.
  • Flexible working arrangements.
  • Annual company overnight retreat

Equal Opportunity Employer

EVOTEK believes that everyone has the ability to make an impact, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing employment opportunity regardless of sex, race, creed, color, gender, religion, marital status, domestic partner status, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, pregnancy, military or veteran status, citizenship status, and genetic information.

data.title: Senior Platform Engineer
data.description:
About Solace

Healthcare in the U.S. is fundamentally broken. The system is so complex that 88% of U.S. adults do not have the health literacy necessary to navigate it without help. Solace cuts through the red tape of healthcare by pairing patients with expert advocates and giving them the tools to make better decisions—and get better outcomes.

We're a Series C startup, founded in 2022 and backed by Inspired Capital, Craft Ventures, Torch Capital, Menlo Ventures, Signalfire, and IVP. Our U.S. based team is lean, mission-driven, and growing quickly.

Solace isn't a place to coast. We're here to redefine healthcare—and that demands urgency, precision, and heart. If you're looking to stretch yourself, sharpen your edge, and do the best work of your life alongside a team that cares deeply, you're in the right place. We’re intense, and we like it that way.

Read more in our Bloomberg funding announcement here.

About the Role

Good plumbing is quiet and invisible, and so is good infrastructure. As a Senior Platform Engineer at Solace, you will join our platform engineering team and help build the infrastructure powering the future of health care. You enable product and data engineers to move aggressively and deploy daily, build safeguards to autonomously recover from failures, and fix things when they can't.

You are a generalist who can work both independently and as part of a team, spanning high-level architecture and low-level foundations. You are curious and always learning. You look deeper than the surface at how systems work, how they fail, and how they can self-heal. You take pride in your craft, have impeccable communication skills, and you absorb feedback exceptionally well. You aren't afraid to make mistakes and learn more from them. Above all, you enjoy taking ownership and are stifled by large organizations.

What You'll Do

  • Help build out our cloud infrastructure and application platform

  • Assess risk and impact for changes to our live environment

  • Join our on-call rotation

  • Troubleshoot problems emerging from complex interactions of technology, governance, and people

  • Design and build autonomous self-healing processes in our systems

  • Be a resource for product and data engineers in your areas of expertise. Learn and grow into other areas of expertise.

  • Communicate with stakeholders and internal platform customers

What You Bring to the Table

Platform engineering requires a diverse and wide-ranging set of skills. We are looking for the following core skills and experiences:

  • Experience working in a start-up environment

  • Experience building scalable infrastructure for hosting web applications or data workloads

  • Deep troubleshooting. You relentlessly dig through architectural and abstraction layers to identify root causes, sometimes under time pressure. You have done this solo and in a team. You have generated and tested hypotheses. You have generated and implemented solutions.

  • Fluent on the command line and comfortable working with Linux

  • Strong communication skills

  • Cloud infrastructure. Experience working with GCP, AWS, or Azure. GCP experience preferred. Bonus for experience working with cloud landing zones. Familiar with GitOps technologies, such as Terraform.

  • Networking. Understanding VPCs, subnets, routes, peering, DNS, load balancers, L4/L7 routing, NAT gateways, CDNs, TLS, and how they all work together.

  • Observability. Integrated and worked with tools such as Datadog and OpenTelemetry for infrastructure monitoring, application performance monitoring, and database performance. Comfortable helping instrument application code, building dashboards, and working with application engineers.

And One or More of the Following Focus Areas:

  • Site reliability. You have improved performance, reliability, and cost across the entire stack, from front-end to back-end.

  • Kubernetes. Understand how to best use its self-healing and extensibility to run workloads scalably, resiliently, and securely, and fix it when it breaks.

  • Polyglot. Comfortable with different languages and learning new ones. Proficient at reading code, understanding what it does, and its operational characteristics during runtime.

  • Devops. Built, optimized, and maintained continuous integration and continuous delivery systems.

  • Developer Product Experience. You built tools and low-friction experiences for product and data engineers, designing and delivering them with a product mindset.

  • Data Infrastructure. You moved databases. Built warehouses, connectors, and replicators. Implemented access controls, optimized and fixed pipelines.

  • Distributed Systems. You built both coordination-bound and coordination-free systems and know the tradeoffs in terms of scalability, reliability, and resilience. You have worked with systems spanning multi-regions. You got your hands dirty fixing systems that collapsed.

  • Security. Worked in a highly-regulated industry such as healthcare with cloud infrastructure

Applicants must be based in the United States.

Up for the Challenge?

We look forward to meeting you.

Fraudulent Recruitment Advisory: Solace Health will NEVER request bank details or offer employment without an interview. All legitimate communications come from official solace.health emails only or ashbyhq.com. Report suspicious activity to recruiting@solace.health or advocate@solace.health.

data.title: Director, Business Systems & AI Enablement
data.description:
Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

Most companies are still talking about AI. We want someone who will put it to work.

As Director, Business Systems & AI Enablement, you'll lead how Partnerize uses technology to run a smarter, faster business. You'll own Salesforce and Asana, the core platforms our teams use every day, along with the integrations that connect them to other business systems such as NetSuite, HubSpot and DocuSign. You'll also bring enterprise AI tools like Google Gemini Enterprise into how we work, so our teams spend less time on manual work and more time on customers and growth.

You'll be a player-coach. You'll lead and develop a small team of two while rolling up your sleeves yourself. One week you might be redesigning a Salesforce sales workflow. The next, you might be building a Gemini agent that removes hours of admin from the Sales team, or presenting ROI results to the executive team.

What you'll own:

  • Business systems: the roadmap, intake, delivery and vendor relationships for Salesforce, Asana and the integrations that connect them across the business.
  • Process optimization: finding friction, redesigning workflows and making sure data stays clean as we scale.
  • AI enablement: rolling out enterprise AI, designing functional agents, driving adoption and measuring the results.

You won't be doing this alone. You'll be part of a leadership group shaping how Partnerize moves into a human-AI enabled future, with one shared goal: a workplace where people and AI do their best work together. Our Director, Product brings the vision for AI in the Partnerize platform. Our Director, Business Performance Optimization brings the framework we use to evaluate new AI opportunities and helps guide proofs of concept. Our People Success team makes sure our people grow alongside the technology. You bring it all to life across the business: working with teams to find where AI can make the biggest difference, then turning big ideas into real change in how we work every day.This role has high visibility and real autonomy. You'll have a direct line to measurable business impact.

Key Responsibilities

1. Business Systems & Process Optimization

  • Salesforce & Asana ownership: Own the configuration, roadmap and health of Salesforce and Asana as our primary business platforms, ensuring they scale with the business and support clean, reliable data.
  • Integration oversight: Oversee the integrations between Salesforce and Asana and connected systems, including NetSuite, HubSpot and DocuSign, so data flows accurately across Sales, Marketing, Finance and Operations.
  • Process optimization: Find friction in how teams work and redesign processes to improve efficiency, data quality and scalability.
  • Requirements and solution design: Partner with stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Finance and Operations to develop user stories, define solution designs and write clear business requirements.
  • Agile delivery: Manage intake and triage for business systems requests. Prioritize and maintain backlogs in Jira so developers can deliver smoothly.
  • Hands-on building: Personally configure, prototype and build solutions (e.g., Salesforce Flows, Asana workflows, Gemini agents) alongside your team.
  • Testing and quality: Own the strategy and execution of user acceptance testing (UAT) so delivered solutions meet business requirements.
  • Change management and enablement: Lead end-user training, documentation, process flows, data dictionaries and communications for new features and workflow changes.

2. AI Enablement & Agent Adoption

This role leads internal AI adoption in close partnership with Product, Business Performance Optimization and People Success.

  • Enterprise AI platform ownership: Act as the internal product owner for enterprise AI platforms, starting with Google Gemini Enterprise. Manage rollouts, end-user enablement, prompt templates and feature adoption.
  • Agent and workflow design: Lead the design, testing and deployment of functional, business-led agents and automated multi-step workflows that remove manual work across teams.
  • AI embedded in core systems: Identify opportunities to embed AI and automation directly into Salesforce and Asana workflows, not just alongside them.
  • AI opportunity delivery: Work with business teams to find high-impact AI use cases. Take them through the Business Performance Optimization evaluation framework, partner on proofs of concept, and lead approved tools from pilot to full rollout.
  • AI governance: Put responsible-use guidelines, data security practices and access controls into practice for internal AI tools, in partnership with IT, Security and Legal.
  • Impact measurement: Define, track and report on business outcomes such as hours saved, cycle-time reduction and adoption rates, with seat utilization as one input, to show the ROI of AI across departments.

3. Leadership & Strategy

  • Team leadership: Lead, coach and develop a team of two business systems professionals, and manage external consultants as needed. Set clear goals, run performance reviews and support ongoing growth.
  • Roadmap and prioritization: Own the consolidated Business Systems and AI roadmap across departments. Balance competing requests against company priorities, and explain "No" or "Not Yet" decisions clearly.
  • Vendor and license management: Manage relationships, SLAs and engagements with software vendors and implementation partners. Oversee renewals and license optimization to control cost.
  • Key partnerships: Work closely with the Director, Product, sharing AI learnings, tools and vendor insights so internal and product AI efforts stay aligned. Partner with the Director, Business Performance Optimization to take AI opportunities through the evaluation framework and proofs of concept to delivered, measurable business results. Work with People Success on AI skills, change readiness and how roles evolve as AI takes on more routine work.
  • Internal champion: Advocate for technology and AI modernization across the company, and communicate the value the Business Systems team delivers to executives and department heads.

What Success Looks Like

  • First 90 days: Assess the current Salesforce, Asana and integration landscape. Build relationships with key stakeholders. Deliver an initial prioritized Business Systems and AI roadmap.
  • First 6 months: Launch at least [X] functional AI agents or automated workflows in production. Establish an AI adoption and impact dashboard. Streamline intake and delivery processes.
  • First 12 months: Reach 100% active adoption of Gemini Enterprise. Show measurable time savings of [X] hours per month across teams. Present a roadmap approved by the executive team for the following year.

What You Bring

Experience

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in business systems, business process optimization or enterprise application management.
  • Experience leading, coaching or managing business analysts, systems administrators or similar roles. You enjoy building as much as leading.
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Administration or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Technical Skills

  • Salesforce: Deep hands-on administrator or power-user experience, including automation (e.g., Flows) and data management.
  • Asana or similar work management platforms: Experience configuring and scaling tools such as Asana, Monday.com, Smartsheet or similar.
  • Integrations: Working knowledge of how core platforms connect to systems like NetSuite, HubSpot and DocuSign. A solid understanding of APIs, data models, ETL and data sync between systems.
  • AI and automation: Practical experience rolling out and driving adoption of commercial AI tools (e.g., Google Gemini Enterprise, ChatGPT Enterprise, Microsoft Copilot), including prompt design, agent or workflow building and measuring impact. Experience with automation platforms (e.g., Zapier, Workato) is a plus.
  • Agile delivery: Experience managing backlogs, prioritizing sprints and writing user stories in Jira.

Leadership & Communication

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical workflows in clear business language.
  • A collaborative style, with experience delivering results through peer partnerships where ownership is shared across functions.
  • Proven ability to manage executive expectations, work through competing requests and apply prioritization frameworks with tact.
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities and technologies.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Salesforce certification(s) (e.g., Administrator, Advanced Administrator, Business Analyst).
  • Experience with Salesforce AI capabilities
  • Familiarity with digital, performance, affiliate or partner marketing.
  • Experience supporting users across multiple regions (EMEA, Americas, APAC).
  • Training or certification in process improvement methods (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma).

US Benefits & Perks

  • Flexible Time Off Policy – Take the time you need
  • Enhanced Parental Leave: 16 weeks for birth parent, 8 weeks for non-birth parent at full pay after one year employment
  • Robust Company Sponsored Health & Welfare Benefits
  • 401k Plan – 4% employee match
  • Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP and Wellness Coaching
  • Regular company events and activities

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization’s success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception.

Privacy and data protection. The data collected as part of this application will be used for the recruitment process and any subsequent employment. You can find further information in Partnerize privacy policy here:

Notice to Recruiters and Staffing Agencies: To protect the interests of all parties, Partnerize will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate or an approved vendor that has a written and signed agreement in place with Partnerize. data.title: 数据开发工程师（实时计算方向）
data.description:
【岗位定位】
1、公司已经建立较完善的数据仓库和实时数据体系，具备数据采集、计算、存储及服务能力。随着业务规模增长和实时应用场景增加，我们希望引入两名中高级数据开发工程师，负责实时数据需求交付、任务优化及工程治理。
2、该岗位以实时数据开发为主，同时参与离线数仓建设。你将重点解决实时链路中的数据延迟、状态膨胀、资源消耗、数据质量及一致性等问题，推动实时数据体系向更稳定、更高效、更规范的方向演进。
【岗位职责】
1、负责实时数据需求的分析、方案设计和开发交付，基于Flink、Kafka等技术建设实时数据处理链路，为实时分析、监控、指标及业务决策等场景提供数据支持。
2、参与实时数仓建设及模型设计，结合业务需求完成数据分层、指标口径、维度模型和数据服务的设计与落地。
3、持续优化现有实时任务，解决数据延迟、反压、Checkpoint异常、状态膨胀、资源利用率不合理及数据不一致等问题，提升任务稳定性和计算效率。
4、参与数据治理和工程质量建设，包括任务依赖梳理、元数据管理、数据质量监控、告警机制、开发规范及问题排查体系建设。
5、参与大数据平台及计算引擎的日常维护和问题处理，协同上下游团队保障数据链路的稳定性、准确性和时效性。
6、沉淀实时开发最佳实践和技术经验，通过技术分享、代码评审及方案评审，提升团队整体实时研发能力。
【任职要求】
1、本科及以上学历，计算机、软件工程、信息技术或相关专业，具有5年及以上数据开发或大数据研发经验；能力优秀者可适当放宽。
2、具备完整的数据仓库项目经验，熟悉实时数仓架构、数据分层和数据模型设计，能够将业务需求转化为数据模型及技术方案。
3、熟练掌握Flink，具有Flink SQL、DataStream API等实际项目经验，理解State、Checkpoint、Watermark、窗口、反压和容错机制。
4、具备实时任务开发及优化经验，能够独立分析和解决任务延迟、资源消耗较高、状态异常、数据倾斜及数据一致性等问题。
5、熟悉Kafka及实时数据链路，理解数据采集、传输、计算、存储和服务的完整流程。
6、熟悉Hadoop、Hive、Spark等大数据技术，具备一定的离线数据开发能力。
7、熟练掌握SQL，能够完成复杂数据加工和性能优化；至少熟悉Python、Java或Scala中的一种开发语言。
8、熟悉MySQL、PostgreSQL、Elasticsearch等常用数据库或存储系统。
9、具备良好的业务理解、沟通协作和书面表达能力，责任心强，能够主动推动问题解决和项目落地。
【加分项】
1、具有大规模Flink任务开发、性能调优或集群治理经验。
2、具有实时数仓架构优化、实时链路治理或技术升级经验。
3、熟悉Hologres、ClickHouse、Doris等实时OLAP技术。
4、具有实时指标、实时监控、实时风控、实时推荐等复杂业务场景经验。
【我们期待的候选人】
1、我们希望你不仅能够完成数据需求开发，也愿意深入理解实时计算机制，关注数据链路的稳定性、性能和工程质量。
2、面对复杂问题，你能够从数据、代码、任务配置和运行机制等多个角度定位原因，并将解决方案沉淀为可复用的规范、工具或最佳实践。
